```{r setup}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
SCRIPT_DIR <- getwd()
REPO_ROOT <- if (basename(SCRIPT_DIR) == "oklahoma" &&
                  basename(dirname(SCRIPT_DIR)) == "inst") {
  normalizePath(file.path(SCRIPT_DIR, "..", ".."), winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
} else {
  normalizePath(SCRIPT_DIR, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
}
# Prefer the local package source so report rendering matches the repo
# (installed PPDisentangle can lag behind and miss helpers like pp_output_path).
if (file.exists(file.path(REPO_ROOT, "DESCRIPTION")) &&
    requireNamespace("pkgload", quietly = TRUE)) {
  pkgload::load_all(REPO_ROOT, quiet = TRUE, export_all = FALSE, helpers = FALSE, attach_testthat = FALSE)
} else if (requireNamespace("PPDisentangle", quietly = TRUE)) {
  library(PPDisentangle)
} else {
  stop("PPDisentangle is not available via local source or installed package.")
}

library(data.table)
library(dplyr)

library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.align = "center", out.width = "100%")
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (!is.null(a)) a else b

DATA_DIR <- file.path(SCRIPT_DIR,
                       "oklahoma_induced_seismicity_data_regional20150318")
candidate_out_dirs <- unique(c(
  PPDisentangle::pp_output_path("oklahoma", repo_root = REPO_ROOT)
))
explicit_result_file <- trimws(Sys.getenv("OK_RESULTS_FILE", ""))
if (nzchar(explicit_result_file) && !file.exists(explicit_result_file)) {
  stop("OK_RESULTS_FILE was provided but does not exist: ", explicit_result_file)
}
# Prefer the canonical publication snapshot when present. Scenario job RDS
# files (univ/obs/biv) can be newer but are not the default main-report source.
canonical_for_paper <- unlist(lapply(candidate_out_dirs, function(d) {
  fp <- file.path(d, "for_paper.rds")
  if (file.exists(fp)) fp else character(0)
}), use.names = FALSE)
result_patterns <- c("^oklahoma_results(_[0-9]+)?\\.rds$",
                     "^oklahoma_results_job([0-9]+)?\\.rds$",
                     "^oklahoma_results_pre_bootstrap(_[0-9]+)?\\.rds$",
                     "^oklahoma_results_pre_bootstrap_job([0-9]+)?\\.rds$",
                     "^for_paper\\.rds$")
candidate_result_files <- unlist(lapply(candidate_out_dirs, function(d) {
  if (!dir.exists(d)) return(character(0))
  unique(unlist(lapply(result_patterns, function(pat) {
    list.files(d, pattern = pat, full.names = TRUE)
  })))
}), use.names = FALSE)
existing_result_files <- candidate_result_files[file.exists(candidate_result_files)]
if (length(existing_result_files) == 0 && length(canonical_for_paper) == 0) {
  stop("No Oklahoma results RDS file found in expected output directories.")
}
result_file <- if (nzchar(explicit_result_file)) {
  normalizePath(explicit_result_file, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
} else if (length(canonical_for_paper) > 0) {
  normalizePath(canonical_for_paper[[1]], winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
} else {
  result_meta <- data.frame(
    file = existing_result_files,
    base = basename(existing_result_files),
    mtime = as.POSIXct(file.info(existing_result_files)$mtime, origin = "1970-01-01"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  result_meta$stage <- ifelse(
    grepl("pre_bootstrap", result_meta$base, fixed = TRUE), "pre_bootstrap", "full"
  )
  result_meta$stage_rank <- match(result_meta$stage, c("pre_bootstrap", "full"))
  job_id <- sub(".*_job([0-9]+).*", "\\1", result_meta$base)
  job_id[!grepl("_job[0-9]+", result_meta$base)] <- NA_character_
  result_meta$run_key <- ifelse(!is.na(job_id), paste0("job:", job_id), "untagged")
  run_latest_idx <- tapply(seq_len(nrow(result_meta)), result_meta$run_key, function(idx) {
    idx[which.max(result_meta$mtime[idx])]
  })
  run_latest_rows <- result_meta[as.integer(run_latest_idx), , drop = FALSE]
  newest_run_key <- run_latest_rows$run_key[which.max(run_latest_rows$mtime)]
  run_pool <- result_meta[result_meta$run_key == newest_run_key, , drop = FALSE]
  best_stage <- max(run_pool$stage_rank, na.rm = TRUE)
  stage_pool <- run_pool[run_pool$stage_rank == best_stage, , drop = FALSE]
  stage_pool$file[which.max(stage_pool$mtime)]
}
OUT_DIR <- dirname(result_file)
candidate_plot_dirs <- unique(file.path(candidate_out_dirs, "plots"))

results <- readRDS(result_file)

# Remap legacy A–L lettering (E/F = all_free primary, duplicate C/D slot, K/L univ homog)
# onto the current A–J scheme (C/D = all_free primary; no K/L).
normalize_oklahoma_fit_letters <- function(res) {
  fn <- res$fits_named
  if (is.null(fn) || !is.list(fn)) return(res)
  e_txt <- if (!is.null(fn$E)) {
    paste(c(fn$E$method, fn$E$label, fn$E$id), collapse = " ")
  } else {
    ""
  }
  e_is_all_free <- grepl("all[_ -]?free", e_txt, ignore.case = TRUE)
  old_scheme <- !is.null(fn$L) || (isTRUE(e_is_all_free) && !is.null(fn$C) && !is.null(fn$E))
  if (!isTRUE(old_scheme)) return(res)
  old <- fn
  remap_one <- function(obj, letter) {
    if (is.null(obj)) return(NULL)
    obj$letter <- letter
    obj
  }
  res$fits_named <- list(
    A = remap_one(old$A, "A"),
    B = remap_one(old$B, "B"),
    C = remap_one(old$E, "C"),
    D = remap_one(old$F, "D"),
    E = remap_one(old$G, "E"),
    F = remap_one(old$H, "F"),
    G = remap_one(old$I, "G"),
    H = remap_one(old$J, "H"),
    I = remap_one(old$K, "I"),
    J = remap_one(old$L, "J")
  )
  boot <- res$bootstrap_ate
  if (is.list(boot)) {
    if (!is.null(boot$fit_E) && is.null(boot$fit_C)) boot$fit_C <- boot$fit_E
    if (!is.null(boot$fit_F) && is.null(boot$fit_D)) boot$fit_D <- boot$fit_F
    res$bootstrap_ate <- boot
  }
  if (!is.null(res$fit_name_map)) {
    res$fit_name_map <- list(
      A = "fits_named$A", B = "fits_named$B",
      C = "fits_named$C", D = "fits_named$D",
      E = "fits_named$E", F = "fits_named$F",
      G = "fits_named$G", H = "fits_named$H",
      I = "fits_named$I", J = "fits_named$J"
    )
  }
  res
}
results <- normalize_oklahoma_fit_letters(results)

meta_for_cfg <- jsonlite::fromJSON(readLines(file.path(DATA_DIR, "metadata.json")))
cfg <- if (!is.null(results$config)) results$config else list()
if (is.null(cfg$ETAS_M0) || length(cfg$ETAS_M0) == 0) {

expected_sens_inner <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(trimws(Sys.getenv("OK_SENS_SEM_INNER_ITER", ""))))
expected_boot_inner <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(trimws(Sys.getenv("OK_BOOT_SEM_INNER_ITER", ""))))

if (is.finite(expected_boot_inner) && !is.na(expected_boot_inner) &&

if (!is.null(pd0)) {

# Default ATE horizon if missing (days post-treatment in design)

path_rel_to <- function(path, start) {
  path <- normalizePath(path, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  start <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  path_seg <- strsplit(path, "/", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]
  start_seg <- strsplit(start, "/", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]
  path_seg <- path_seg[nzchar(path_seg)]
  start_seg <- start_seg[nzchar(start_seg)]
  n <- min(length(path_seg), length(start_seg))
  i <- 1L
  while (i <= n && identical(path_seg[[i]], start_seg[[i]])) i <- i + 1L
  rel_parts <- c(rep("..", length(start_seg) - i + 1L), path_seg[i:length(path_seg)])
  if (length(rel_parts) < 1L) "." else paste(rel_parts, collapse = "/")
}

resolve_plot_file <- function(filename) {
  plot_dirs <- unique(c(file.path(OUT_DIR, "plots"), candidate_plot_dirs))
  candidates <- file.path(plot_dirs, filename)
  existing <- candidates[file.exists(candidates)]
  if (length(existing) > 0) {
    abs_path <- existing[which.max(file.info(existing)$mtime)]
    return(path_rel_to(abs_path, SCRIPT_DIR))
  }
  stem <- sub("\\.[^.]+$", "", filename)
  ext <- sub("^.*(\\.[^.]+)$", "\\1", filename)
  ext <- if (identical(ext, filename)) "" else ext
  tagged_pat <- paste0("^", gsub("([.|()\\^{}+$*?\\[\\]\\\\])", "\\\\\\1", stem), "_job[0-9]+", gsub("([.|()\\^{}+$*?\\[\\]\\\\])", "\\\\\\1", ext), "$")
  tagged <- unlist(lapply(plot_dirs, function(d) {
    if (!dir.exists(d)) return(character(0))
    list.files(d, pattern = tagged_pat, full.names = TRUE)
  }), use.names = FALSE)
  tagged <- tagged[file.exists(tagged)]
  if (length(tagged) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  path_rel_to(tagged[which.max(file.info(tagged)$mtime)], SCRIPT_DIR)
}

render_timestamp <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z")

# KDE/config scalars may be NULL, list-wrapped, or non-numeric after saveRDS / merges.
fmt_scaled_num <- function(x, digits = 2) {
  if (is.null(x)) return("N/A")
  xv <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(unlist(x, use.names = FALSE)))
  xv <- xv[is.finite(xv)]
  if (length(xv) < 1L) return("N/A")
  as.character(round(xv[[1]], digits))
}

# NULL / none / non-positive SEM_T_TRUNC_DAYS means untruncated Omori (p > 1).
fmt_t_trunc_cfg <- function(x, digits = 4) {
  tryCatch(
    PPDisentangle:::.etas_format_t_trunc_days(x, digits = digits),
    error = function(e) "none"
  )
}

has_fit <- function(fit_name) {
  !is.null(results[[fit_name]])
}

coerce_pp_df <- function(obj) {
  if (is.null(obj)) return(data.frame())

  # Handle spatstat point-pattern objects.
  if (inherits(obj, "ppp")) {
    out <- data.frame(x = obj$x, y = obj$y)
    if (!is.null(obj$marks)) {
      marks_df <- as.data.frame(obj$marks)
      out <- cbind(out, marks_df, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    }
    return(out)
  }

  # Standard data-frame-like objects.
  if (is.data.frame(obj)) return(as.data.frame(obj))
  if (is.matrix(obj)) return(as.data.frame(obj))

  # Common list structure with coordinate/time vectors.
  if (is.list(obj) && all(c("x", "y") %in% names(obj))) {
    n <- min(length(obj$x), length(obj$y))
    out <- data.frame(
      x = as.numeric(obj$x)[seq_len(n)],
      y = as.numeric(obj$y)[seq_len(n)]
    )
    if ("t" %in% names(obj)) out$t <- as.numeric(obj$t)[seq_len(min(n, length(obj$t)))]
    for (nm in setdiff(names(obj), c("x", "y", "t"))) {
      v <- obj[[nm]]
      if (length(v) >= n && is.atomic(v)) out[[nm]] <- v[seq_len(n)]
    }
    return(out)
  }

  # Last fallback.
  out <- tryCatch(as.data.frame(obj), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(out)) {
    stop("Could not coerce point-pattern object to data frame for plotting.")
  }
  out
}
```

# Introduction

**Report rendered at:** `r render_timestamp`

**Results source:** `r basename(result_file)` `r if (using_pre_bootstrap) "(pre-bootstrap checkpoint)" else "(full results)"`

On 18 March 2015 the Oklahoma Corporation Commission (OCC) issued
directive **AOI_20150318**, requiring operators within a defined Area of
Interest (AOI) in central Oklahoma to reduce wastewater disposal volumes.
This report estimates the **all-or-nothing causal effect** of the
directive on earthquake rates using the **PPDisentangle** framework.
Counterfactual evaluations use the **full bivariate** ETAS law
(including cross-excitation).

## Estimand

The target quantity is the **all-or-nothing total treatment effect**
under the fitted bivariate law: the expected difference in total
earthquake counts between a world in which *every tile of the primary
tessellation* receives the directive ($\mathbf{Z}=(1,\dots,1)$) and a
world in which *no tile* receives it ($\mathbf{Z}=(0,\dots,0)$):

$$
\Delta_{\text{AoN}}
= \bigl\{
   \mathbb{E}\!\bigl[N(\mathbf{1})\bigr]
  -\mathbb{E}\!\bigl[N(\mathbf{0})\bigr]
\bigr\},
$$

where $N(\mathbf{z})$ denotes the total event count under treatment
assignment $\mathbf{z}$.

## Models

Primary tessellation (`r primary_partition_id`) publication pair:

| Label | Model | Background | Labels |
|:---:|:---|:---|:---|
| **C** | Naive bivariate ETAS | KDE (non-parametric) | Location-based |
| **D** | SEM bivariate ETAS | KDE (non-parametric) | SEM-corrected |

All fits fix $\gamma\equiv 0$ (magnitude-independent spatial scale $d(m)=D$).
```{r cd-only-scope}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (isTRUE(cfg$CD_ONLY)) {
  cat(
    "This artifact is a **C/D-only** run: only the primary naive (C) and SEM (D) ",
    "KDE bivariate fits were estimated. Homogeneous A/B, structural E/F, ",
    "univariate G–J, bootstrap, and tessellation/bandwidth/t-trunc sensitivities ",
    "were not run. Sections below that depend on those outputs will say so.\n",
    sep = ""
  )
} else {
  cat(
    "**A/B** homogeneous bivariate (all-free except $\\gamma$); ",
    "**C/D** KDE all-free (primary); ",
    "**E/F** KDE with structural $(c,p,D,q)$ fixed from first-half control pre-treatment; ",
    "**G/H** univariate+KDE; **I/J** univariate homogeneous (no KDE). ",
    "Partition-sensitivity refits use the same C/D (all-free) specifications on ",
    "alternative tessellations.\n",
    sep = ""
  )
}
```

# Study Design

```{r design}
#| label: design
meta <- jsonlite::fromJSON(readLines(file.path(DATA_DIR, "metadata.json")))
```

**Treatment.** OCC directive AOI_20150318: mandatory reduction in
wastewater disposal volumes within the AOI.

**Primary tessellation.** `r primary_partition_id`
(`r cfg$n_tiles` tiles, `r cfg$n_treated` treated).
Default is a 1× triggering-range grid whose treated tiles are those whose
centroid falls inside the OCC AOI.

**County tessellation (sensitivity).** The `r cty$n_counties` Oklahoma
counties (US Census Bureau via `tigris`). Counties whose centroid falls
inside the AOI are treated.

**Treated counties** (`r cty$n_treated`):
`r paste(cty$treated_names, collapse = ", ")`.

**Temporal windows.**

- Pre-treatment: `r meta$design$pre_start_utc` to `r meta$design$t_star_utc`
- Post-treatment: `r meta$design$t_star_utc` to `r meta$design$post_end_utc`

**Magnitude threshold.** $m_0 =$ `r cfg$ETAS_M0`.

**Event counts.**
- Pre-treatment total: `r if (!is.null(cfg$n_pre_total)) cfg$n_pre_total else cfg$n_pre`
- Pre-treatment holdout (first 50%): `r if (!is.null(cfg$n_pre_holdout)) cfg$n_pre_holdout else NA`
- Pre-treatment used for estimation/carryover (second 50%): `r cfg$n_pre`
- Post-treatment: `r cfg$n_post`
- Total used in SEM estimation (used pre + post): `r cfg$n_pre + cfg$n_post`

# Data

```{r load-data}
#| label: load-data
ev_all <- fread(file.path(DATA_DIR, "events_all.csv"))
t_star_utc <- as.POSIXct(meta$design$t_star_utc, tz = "UTC")
ev_all[, time_utc := as.POSIXct(time_utc, tz = "UTC")]
ev_all[, t_days := as.numeric(difftime(time_utc, t_star_utc, units = "days"))]
ev_all <- ev_all[mag >= cfg$ETAS_M0]
pp_pre  <- results$pp_data$pp_pre
pp_post <- results$pp_data$pp_post
pp_pre <- coerce_pp_df(pp_pre)
pp_post <- coerce_pp_df(pp_post)
if (!("t" %in% names(pp_pre))) pp_pre$t <- numeric(nrow(pp_pre))
if (!("t" %in% names(pp_post))) pp_post$t <- numeric(nrow(pp_post))
```

## Tessellation Partition

# Model

## ETAS Conditional Intensity

$$
\lambda(t,x,y) = \frac{\mu}{|S|} + \sum_{j:\,t_j<t} A\,e^{\alpha_m(m_j-m_0)}\,g(t-t_j)\,f(x-x_j,y-y_j\mid m_j)
$$

with Omori--Utsu temporal kernel $g$ and power-law spatial kernel $f$.

The kernels used in the fits are:

$$
g(\Delta t) = \frac{p-1}{c}\left(1+\frac{\Delta t}{c}\right)^{-p}, \qquad \Delta t > 0
$$

and

$$
f(\Delta x,\Delta y \mid m_j) =
\frac{q-1}{\pi\,D}\,
\left(1+\frac{r^2}{D}\right)^{-q},
\quad r^2 = \Delta x^2 + \Delta y^2.
$$

The spatial scale is **magnitude-independent**: we fix $\gamma\equiv 0$ in
every fit (equivalently $d(m)=D$), so larger events are more productive only
through $\alpha_m>0$, not through a wider spatial kernel.

## Bivariate Extension

$$
\lambda_k(t,x,y) = \frac{\mu_k}{|S_k|}\,W_k(x,y) + \sum_{l\in\{0,1\}}\sum_{\substack{j:\,t_j<t\\Z_j=l}} A_{kl}\,e^{\alpha_{m,kl}(m_j-m_0)}\,g(t-t_j)\,f(x-x_j,y-y_j\mid m_j)
$$

Off-diagonal terms $A_{01}$ (treated$\to$control) and $A_{10}$
(control$\to$treated) capture cross-excitation. For the KDE background
models (C, D, G, H), $W_k(x,y)$ is the normalized kernel density estimate from
control pre-treatment data; for the homogeneous models (A, B, I, J),
$W_k \equiv 1$.

## Branching Matrix, Spectral Radius, and Explosiveness

The bivariate ETAS law admits a Poisson-cluster (branching) representation.
Averaging productivity over magnitudes under a Gutenberg–Richter law with
slope $\beta$ (here $\beta=`r signif(as.numeric(cfg$BETA_GR %||% 2.3), 3)`$)
gives the expected number of type-$k$ offspring of a type-$\ell$ parent,

$$
\eta_{k\ell}
=
A_{k\ell}\,\frac{\beta}{\beta-\alpha_{m,k\ell}},
\qquad
\alpha_{m,k\ell}<\beta
$$

(and $\eta_{k\ell}=\infty$ if $\alpha_{m,k\ell}\ge\beta$). These four
channel means form the **reproduction matrix**

$$
M
=
\begin{pmatrix}
\eta_{00} & \eta_{01} \\
\eta_{10} & \eta_{11}
\end{pmatrix}.
$$

Its **spectral radius** $\rho(M)=\max\{|\lambda|:\lambda\text{ eigenvalue of }M\}$
is the long-run growth factor of a typical cluster:

- $\rho(M)<1$ (**subcritical**): clusters die out almost surely; the expected
  total progeny of one immigrant is finite, equal to
  $\mathbf{1}^\top(I-M)^{-1}\mathbf{e}_\ell$ from a type-$\ell$ immigrant.
  Mean event counts over a finite horizon are well-defined, so all-or-nothing
  DAITE contrasts computed by forward simulation are meaningful.
- $\rho(M)=1$ (**critical**): expected cluster size diverges; finite-horizon
  counts remain random but have heavy tails.
- $\rho(M)>1$ (**explosive / supercritical**): clusters grow exponentially in
  expectation. Simulated catalogues routinely explode, and plug-in causal
  contrasts become numerically unstable and scientifically uninterpretable
  as finite expected savings.

In the independent (univariate) case there is no cross-excitation, so
$M=\mathrm{diag}(\eta_0,\eta_1)$ and $\rho(M)=\max(\eta_0,\eta_1)$: each
margin is checked separately. With cross-excitation, even two subcritical
self-excitation ratios can combine with large off-diagonal $\eta_{01},\eta_{10}$
to push $\rho(M)$ above one.

Fits in this analysis enforce a hard subcritical constraint
$\rho(M)<`r signif(as.numeric(cfg$ETAS_BRANCHING_MAX %||% 0.98), 3)`$
(and $\alpha_m>0$), projecting productivity when needed. Parameter tables
below report $\rho$ and an explosive flag for each fitted law.

## Likelihood Truncation in This Run

For ETAS likelihood evaluation in this project, temporal triggering is
truncated at a finite horizon `t_trunc` (days) when enabled. In code,
parent-child contributions with $\Delta t > t_{\text{trunc}}$ are dropped
from the triggering sum. The Omori part in the **log-intensity** is scaled by

$$
\text{temporal\_norm}
= 1 - \left(1 + \frac{t_{\text{trunc}}}{c}\right)^{-(p-1)},
$$

so $p$ directly controls how much triggering mass remains inside the truncation
window. Larger $p$ concentrates mass near zero lag (less tail), smaller $p$
leaves heavier temporal tails. With a finite horizon any $p>0$ is a valid
density. When truncation is off (`SEM_T_TRUNC_DAYS = none`), the untruncated
Omori law is used and the fit enforces $p>1$. Do not compare log-likelihoods
across different truncation settings.

The spatial exponent $q$ does **not** interact with temporal truncation directly.
It continues to govern spatial tail decay in
$f(r\mid m)\propto (1+r^2/d(m))^{-q}$, while truncation only limits temporal
history depth.

```{r tbl-truncation-params}
#| label: tbl-truncation-params
safe_num <- function(x) {
  v <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  if (length(v) < 1L) return(NA_real_)
  v <- v[[1]]
  if (is.finite(v)) v else NA_real_
}
fs <- cfg$FIXED_STRUCTURAL
c_val <- if (!is.null(fs)) safe_num(fs[["c"]]) else NA_real_
p_val <- if (!is.null(fs)) safe_num(fs[["p"]]) else NA_real_
q_val <- if (!is.null(fs)) safe_num(fs[["q"]]) else NA_real_
ttr <- safe_num(cfg$SEM_T_TRUNC_DAYS)
rel_target <- safe_num(cfg$SEM_T_TRUNC_REL)
t_source <- if (!is.null(cfg$SEM_T_TRUNC_SOURCE)) as.character(cfg$SEM_T_TRUNC_SOURCE[[1]]) else "N/A"

temporal_mass_retained <- if (is.finite(ttr) && is.finite(c_val) && is.finite(p_val) && c_val > 0 && p_val > 1) {
  1 - (1 + ttr / c_val)^(-(p_val - 1))
} else NA_real_
tail_mass_dropped <- if (is.finite(temporal_mass_retained)) 1 - temporal_mass_retained else NA_real_
kernel_rel_at_ttr <- if (is.finite(ttr) && is.finite(c_val) && is.finite(p_val) && c_val > 0) {
  (1 + ttr / c_val)^(-p_val)
} else NA_real_

p_bound <- safe_num(cfg$ETAS_P_LOWER_BOUND)
trunc_df <- data.frame(
  Setting = c(
    "SEM t_trunc (days)",
    "SEM t_trunc source",
    "Untruncated Omori (p > 1)",
    "ETAS p lower bound",
    "Legacy auto-trunc rel level (unused)",
    "Structural c (Omori offset)",
    "Structural p (temporal exponent)",
    "Structural q (spatial exponent)",
    "Temporal mass retained up to t_trunc",
    "Temporal tail mass dropped beyond t_trunc",
    "Relative Omori kernel at t_trunc: ((t_trunc+c)/c)^(-p)"
  ),
  Value = c(
    fmt_t_trunc_cfg(cfg$SEM_T_TRUNC_DAYS),
    t_source,
    if (isTRUE(cfg$SEM_NO_TRUNCATION)) "yes" else if (is.finite(ttr)) "no" else "N/A",
    if (is.finite(p_bound)) sprintf("%.4f", p_bound) else "N/A",
    if (is.finite(rel_target)) sprintf("%.4f", rel_target) else "N/A",
    if (is.finite(c_val)) sprintf("%.4f", c_val) else "N/A",
    if (is.finite(p_val)) sprintf("%.4f", p_val) else "N/A",
    if (is.finite(q_val)) sprintf("%.4f", q_val) else "N/A",
    if (is.finite(temporal_mass_retained)) sprintf("%.4f", temporal_mass_retained) else "N/A",
    if (is.finite(tail_mass_dropped)) sprintf("%.4f", tail_mass_dropped) else "N/A",
    if (is.finite(kernel_rel_at_ttr)) sprintf("%.6f", kernel_rel_at_ttr) else "N/A"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
kable(trunc_df, align = "lc",
      caption = "Temporal truncation settings and implied Omori-tail diagnostics used in likelihood/simulation.") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover"), full_width = FALSE)
```

The truncation-horizon grid below refits **Fit C** (naive bivariate + KDE) and
**Fit D** (SEM bivariate + KDE) at each `t_trunc`, then recomputes the
bivariate all-or-nothing contrast. Fit C is a single MLE so it is cheap
relative to SEM. Older results files that only stored Fit D still render
the D columns.

```{r prep-t-trunc-sensitivity}
#| label: prep-t-trunc-sensitivity
#| include: false
one_num <- function(x) {
  v <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(unlist(x, use.names = FALSE)))
  if (length(v) < 1L) NA_real_ else v[[1]]
}
one_int <- function(x) {
  v <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(unlist(x, use.names = FALSE)))
  if (length(v) < 1L) NA_integer_ else v[[1]]
}
one_chr <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(unlist(x, use.names = FALSE)) < 1L) NA_character_ else as.character(unlist(x, use.names = FALSE)[[1]])
}
trunc_sens <- results$t_trunc_sensitivity
trunc_sens_df <- NULL
trunc_sens_plot_df <- NULL
trunc_sens_has_c <- FALSE
trunc_sens_main_ttr <- one_num(cfg$SEM_T_TRUNC_DAYS)
if (!is.null(trunc_sens) && length(trunc_sens) >= 1L) {
  rows <- lapply(trunc_sens, function(x) {
    if (is.null(x)) return(NULL)
    data.frame(
      t_trunc_days = one_num(x$t_trunc_days),
      C_status = one_chr(x$C_status),
      D_status = one_chr(x$D_status %||% x$status),
      C_mean_saved = one_num(x$C_ate_mean_saved),
      C_sd_saved = one_num(x$C_ate_sd_saved),
      C_n_sims = one_int(x$C_ate_n_sims),
      D_mean_saved = one_num(x$ate_mean_saved),
      D_sd_saved = one_num(x$ate_sd_saved),
      D_n_sims = one_int(x$ate_n_sims),
      n_relabel = one_int(x$n_relabel),
      elapsed_min = one_num(x$elapsed_sec) / 60,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  trunc_sens_df <- do.call(rbind, rows[!vapply(rows, is.null, logical(1))])
  if (!is.null(trunc_sens_df) && nrow(trunc_sens_df) >= 1L) {
    trunc_ord <- trunc_sens_df$t_trunc_days
    trunc_ord[!is.finite(trunc_ord)] <- Inf
    trunc_sens_df <- trunc_sens_df[order(trunc_ord), , drop = FALSE]
    trunc_sens_has_c <- any(is.finite(trunc_sens_df$C_mean_saved) |
                              (!is.na(trunc_sens_df$C_status) & nzchar(trunc_sens_df$C_status)))
    plot_rows <- list(
      data.frame(
        t_trunc_days = trunc_sens_df$t_trunc_days,
        Fit = "D: SEM biv+KDE",
        mean_saved = trunc_sens_df$D_mean_saved,
        sd_saved = trunc_sens_df$D_sd_saved,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    )
    if (isTRUE(trunc_sens_has_c)) {
      plot_rows <- c(
        list(data.frame(
          t_trunc_days = trunc_sens_df$t_trunc_days,
          Fit = "C: Naive biv+KDE",
          mean_saved = trunc_sens_df$C_mean_saved,
          sd_saved = trunc_sens_df$C_sd_saved,
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )),
        plot_rows
      )
    }
    trunc_sens_plot_df <- do.call(rbind, plot_rows)
  } else {
    trunc_sens_df <- NULL
  }
}
```

```{r tbl-t-trunc-sensitivity}
#| label: tbl-t-trunc-sensitivity
if (is.null(trunc_sens_df)) {
  cat("No Fit C/D t_trunc sensitivity grid was saved in this results file.\n")
} else {
  cap <- if (isTRUE(trunc_sens_has_c)) {
    "Fit C (naive biv+KDE) and Fit D (SEM biv+KDE) all-or-nothing ATE vs temporal truncation horizon."
  } else {
    "Fit D (SEM biv+KDE) all-or-nothing ATE vs temporal truncation horizon."
  }
  cap <- paste0(cap, sprintf(" Main-run t_trunc=%s.", fmt_t_trunc_cfg(cfg$SEM_T_TRUNC_DAYS)))
  tbl <- if (isTRUE(trunc_sens_has_c)) {
    trunc_sens_df |>
      transmute(
        `t_trunc (days)` = ifelse(is.finite(t_trunc_days), sprintf("%.3g", t_trunc_days), "none"),
        `C status` = ifelse(is.na(C_status) | !nzchar(C_status), "NA", C_status),
        `C mean saved` = ifelse(is.finite(C_mean_saved), sprintf("%.1f", C_mean_saved), "NA"),
        `C SD` = ifelse(is.finite(C_sd_saved), sprintf("%.1f", C_sd_saved), "NA"),
        `D status` = ifelse(is.na(D_status) | !nzchar(D_status), "NA", D_status),
        `D mean saved` = ifelse(is.finite(D_mean_saved), sprintf("%.1f", D_mean_saved), "NA"),
        `D SD` = ifelse(is.finite(D_sd_saved), sprintf("%.1f", D_sd_saved), "NA"),
        Relabels = ifelse(is.finite(n_relabel), as.character(n_relabel), "NA"),
        `Elapsed (min)` = ifelse(is.finite(elapsed_min), sprintf("%.1f", elapsed_min), "NA")
      )
  } else {
    trunc_sens_df |>
      transmute(
        `t_trunc (days)` = ifelse(is.finite(t_trunc_days), sprintf("%.3g", t_trunc_days), "none"),
        Status = D_status,
        `Mean saved` = ifelse(is.finite(D_mean_saved), sprintf("%.1f", D_mean_saved), "NA"),
        `SD saved` = ifelse(is.finite(D_sd_saved), sprintf("%.1f", D_sd_saved), "NA"),
        `ATE sims` = ifelse(is.finite(D_n_sims), as.character(D_n_sims), "NA"),
        Relabels = ifelse(is.finite(n_relabel), as.character(n_relabel), "NA"),
        `Elapsed (min)` = ifelse(is.finite(elapsed_min), sprintf("%.1f", elapsed_min), "NA")
      )
  }
  knitr::kable(tbl, align = "lcccccccc", caption = cap, row.names = FALSE) |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)
}
```

```{r fig-t-trunc-sensitivity}
      ),
      width = 0.4, alpha = 0.7,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(
      values = c("C: Naive biv+KDE" = "#fdb462", "D: SEM biv+KDE" = "#80b1d3")
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = "Fit C/D ATE vs temporal truncation",
      x = expression(t[trunc]~"(days)"),
      y = "Mean saved events (AoN)",
      colour = NULL
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
    ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "top")
  if (is.finite(trunc_sens_main_ttr)) {
    p_trunc <- p_trunc +
      ggplot2::geom_vline(
        xintercept = trunc_sens_main_ttr, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40"
      )
  }
  print(p_trunc)
}
```

## Non-Parametric Background Rate

```{r tbl-kde}
#| label: tbl-kde
kde <- results$kde_info
if (is.null(kde)) {
  kde_df <- data.frame(
    Setting = "KDE summary",
    Value = paste0("Not stored in this results file. ",
                   if (using_pre_bootstrap) {
                     "Re-run oklahoma_analysis.R through the pre-bootstrap checkpoint (current script saves kde_info), or use full oklahoma_results.rds."
                   } else {
                     "Use a full results RDS that includes kde_info."
                   }),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
} else {
  kde_holdout <- if (!is.null(kde$n_pre_holdout)) kde$n_pre_holdout else NA
  kde_used <- if (!is.null(kde$n_pre_used)) kde$n_pre_used else NA
  kde_df <- data.frame(
    Setting = c("KDE training events (held-out control pre)",
                "Held-out pre-treatment events (all processes)",
                "Pre-treatment events used for estimation",
                "Bandwidth (km)", "Estimated triggering range (km)", "Method"),
    Value = c(kde$n_training, kde_holdout, kde_used,
              fmt_scaled_num(kde$bw_sigma), fmt_scaled_num(kde$trigger_range_km),
              if (!is.null(kde$bw_label)) kde$bw_label else if (!is.null(kde$bw_method)) kde$bw_method else "2 x Diggle CV"))
}
kable(kde_df, align = "lc",
      caption = "KDE background rate estimation details.") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover"), full_width = FALSE)
```

Only the **second 50%** of pre-treatment events are used for
estimation/carryover in both homogeneous and inhomogeneous SEM fits.
The **first 50%** is held out for fairness; in the inhomogeneous case,
its control events are used to estimate the KDE background
(`r if (!is.null(kde) && !is.null(kde$bw_label)) kde$bw_label else if (!is.null(kde) && !is.null(kde$bw_method)) kde$bw_method else "configured bandwidth method"`).

## KDE bandwidth sensitivity

Fit C (naive bivariate + KDE) and Fit D (SEM bivariate + KDE) are refit on an
isotropic Gaussian bandwidth grid at the same temporal truncation as the main
run. Saved events use the bivariate all-or-nothing contrast.

```{r prep-kde-bw-sensitivity}
#| label: prep-kde-bw-sensitivity
#| include: false
bw_sens <- results$kde_bandwidth_sensitivity
bw_sens_df <- NULL
bw_sens_plot_df <- NULL
bw_sens_has_c <- FALSE
ate_saved_from_obj <- function(ate_obj) {
  if (is.null(ate_obj) || is.null(ate_obj$all_nothing_sim$total_saved)) {
    return(list(mean = NA_real_, sd = NA_real_, n = NA_integer_))
  }
  saved <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(ate_obj$all_nothing_sim$total_saved))
  saved <- saved[is.finite(saved)]
  list(
    mean = if (length(saved) > 0L) mean(saved) else NA_real_,
    sd = if (length(saved) > 1L) stats::sd(saved) else NA_real_,
    n = as.integer(length(saved))
  )
}
if (!is.null(bw_sens) && length(bw_sens) >= 1L) {
  rows <- lapply(bw_sens, function(x) {
    if (is.null(x)) return(NULL)
    d_mean <- one_num(x$ate_mean_saved)
    d_sd <- one_num(x$ate_sd_saved)
    d_n <- one_int(x$ate_n_sims)
    if (!is.finite(d_mean)) {
      d_stats <- ate_saved_from_obj(x$ate_F)
      d_mean <- d_stats$mean
      d_sd <- d_stats$sd
      d_n <- d_stats$n
    }
    c_mean <- one_num(x$C_ate_mean_saved)
    c_sd <- one_num(x$C_ate_sd_saved)
    c_n <- one_int(x$C_ate_n_sims)
    if (!is.finite(c_mean)) {
      c_stats <- ate_saved_from_obj(x$ate_E)
      c_mean <- c_stats$mean
      c_sd <- c_stats$sd
      c_n <- c_stats$n
    }
    data.frame(
      label = one_chr(x$label),
      sigma_km = one_num(x$sigma),
      C_mean_saved = c_mean,
      C_sd_saved = c_sd,
      C_n_sims = c_n,
      D_mean_saved = d_mean,
      D_sd_saved = d_sd,
      D_n_sims = d_n,
      n_relabel = one_int(x$n_relabel),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  bw_sens_df <- do.call(rbind, rows[!vapply(rows, is.null, logical(1))])
  if (!is.null(bw_sens_df) && nrow(bw_sens_df) >= 1L) {
    bw_sens_df <- bw_sens_df[order(bw_sens_df$sigma_km, bw_sens_df$label), , drop = FALSE]
    bw_sens_has_c <- any(is.finite(bw_sens_df$C_mean_saved))
    plot_rows <- list(
      data.frame(
        sigma_km = bw_sens_df$sigma_km,
        Fit = "D: SEM biv+KDE",
        mean_saved = bw_sens_df$D_mean_saved,
        sd_saved = bw_sens_df$D_sd_saved,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    )
    if (isTRUE(bw_sens_has_c)) {
      plot_rows <- c(
        list(data.frame(
          sigma_km = bw_sens_df$sigma_km,
          Fit = "C: Naive biv+KDE",
          mean_saved = bw_sens_df$C_mean_saved,
          sd_saved = bw_sens_df$C_sd_saved,
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )),
        plot_rows
      )
    }
    bw_sens_plot_df <- do.call(rbind, plot_rows)
  } else {
    bw_sens_df <- NULL
  }
}
```

```{r tbl-kde-bw-sensitivity}

} else {
```

## SEM Configuration

Pilot tuning is optional and only targets the Model D SEM relabelling controls.
When enabled, the code runs a parallel grid over:

- `change_factor`
- `change_factor_min_mult`
- `change_factor_max_mult`
- `selection_temperature`

using a short inner SEM run (default 100 iterations), then ranks candidates by:
high final SEM score and low tail accepted/average flips. The chosen settings are
then used for the main primary-tessellation SEM fits in the run.

```{r sem-final-config}
#| label: sem-final-config

  if (length(x) < 1L || is.null(x) || all(is.na(x))) return(default)

}

  ),

  ),

)
```

# Results — Tessellation Partition

```{r extract}
#| label: extract
get_fit_by_letter <- function(letter, legacy_key = NULL) {
  if (!is.null(results$fits_named) && !is.null(results$fits_named[[letter]])) {
    return(results$fits_named[[letter]])
  }
  if (!is.null(legacy_key) && !is.null(results[[legacy_key]])) return(results[[legacy_key]])
  NULL
}

fit_A_obj <- get_fit_by_letter("A", "fitB")
fit_B_obj <- get_fit_by_letter("B", "fitD")
# Primary all_free C/D; legacy top-level fitE/fitF alias the same content.
fit_C_obj <- get_fit_by_letter("C", "fitE")
fit_D_obj <- get_fit_by_letter("D", "fitF")
fit_E_obj <- get_fit_by_letter("E")
fit_F_obj <- get_fit_by_letter("F")
# Univ+KDE G/H (legacy fitI/fitJ); univ homog I/J (legacy fitK/fitL).
fit_G_obj <- get_fit_by_letter("G", "fitI")
fit_H_obj <- get_fit_by_letter("H", "fitJ")
fit_I_obj <- get_fit_by_letter("I", "fitK")
fit_J_obj <- get_fit_by_letter("J", "fitL")
# Optional K/L fallbacks after normalize (prefer clean A–J above).
fit_K_obj <- get_fit_by_letter("K", "fitK")
if (is.null(fit_K_obj)) fit_K_obj <- fit_I_obj
fit_L_obj <- get_fit_by_letter("L", "fitL")
if (is.null(fit_L_obj)) fit_L_obj <- fit_J_obj

A_par <- if (!is.null(fit_A_obj)) fit_A_obj$params else NULL
B_par <- if (!is.null(fit_B_obj)) fit_B_obj$params else NULL
C_par <- if (!is.null(fit_C_obj)) fit_C_obj$params else NULL
D_par <- if (!is.null(fit_D_obj)) fit_D_obj$params else NULL
E_par <- if (!is.null(fit_E_obj)) fit_E_obj$params else NULL
F_par <- if (!is.null(fit_F_obj)) fit_F_obj$params else NULL
G_par <- if (!is.null(fit_G_obj)) fit_G_obj$params else NULL
H_par <- if (!is.null(fit_H_obj)) fit_H_obj$params else NULL
I_par <- if (!is.null(fit_I_obj)) fit_I_obj$params else NULL
J_par <- if (!is.null(fit_J_obj)) fit_J_obj$params else NULL

scalar_num_or_na <- function(x) {
  v <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  if (length(v) < 1L) return(NA_real_)
  v <- v[[1]]
  if (is.finite(v)) v else NA_real_
}

bc <- function(par, p) {
  if (is.null(par)) return(NA_real_)
  if (is.list(par) && !is.null(par$control)) {
    return(scalar_num_or_na(par$control[[p]]))
  }
  if (p == "mu") {
    v <- scalar_num_or_na(par[["mu_0"]])
    if (is.finite(v)) return(v)
    v <- scalar_num_or_na(par[["mu"]])
    if (is.finite(v)) return(v)
  }
  v <- scalar_num_or_na(par[[paste0(p, "_00")]])
  if (is.finite(v)) return(v)
  scalar_num_or_na(par[[p]])
}
bt <- function(par, p) {
  if (is.null(par)) return(NA_real_)
  if (is.list(par) && !is.null(par$treated)) {
    return(scalar_num_or_na(par$treated[[p]]))
  }
  if (p == "mu") {
    v <- scalar_num_or_na(par[["mu_1"]])
    if (is.finite(v)) return(v)
    v <- scalar_num_or_na(par[["mu"]])
    if (is.finite(v)) return(v)
  }
  v <- scalar_num_or_na(par[[paste0(p, "_11")]])
  if (is.finite(v)) return(v)
  scalar_num_or_na(par[[p]])
}
safe_bc <- function(par, p) if (is.null(par)) NA_real_ else bc(par, p)
safe_bt <- function(par, p) if (is.null(par)) NA_real_ else bt(par, p)

etas_trigger_means <- function(par, beta_gr = NULL, t_trunc_days = NULL) {
  if (is.null(par)) {
    return(list(mean_time = NA_real_, mean_time_trunc = NA_real_, mean_distance = NA_real_, mean_scale = NA_real_))
  }
  c0 <- scalar_num_or_na(par[["c"]])
  p0 <- scalar_num_or_na(par[["p"]])
  D0 <- scalar_num_or_na(par[["D"]])
  g0 <- scalar_num_or_na(par[["gamma"]])
  q0 <- scalar_num_or_na(par[["q"]])
  ttr <- scalar_num_or_na(t_trunc_days)
  b0_vec <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(unlist(beta_gr, use.names = FALSE)))
  b0 <- if (length(b0_vec) < 1L) NA_real_ else scalar_num_or_na(b0_vec[[1]])
  if (!is.finite(b0) || b0 <= 0) b0 <- 2.3

  mean_time <- if (is.finite(c0) && is.finite(p0) && !is.na(c0) && !is.na(p0) && p0 > 2) {
    c0 / (p0 - 2)
  } else {
    Inf
  }
  mean_time_trunc <- NA_real_
  if (is.finite(c0) && is.finite(p0) && !is.na(c0) && !is.na(p0) &&
      c0 > 0 && p0 > 1 && is.finite(ttr) && !is.na(ttr) && ttr > 0) {
    u <- 1 + (ttr / c0)
    if (p0 > 1 && p0 != 2) {
      i0 <- (c0 / (p0 - 1)) * (1 - u^(1 - p0))
      i1 <- c0^2 * ((u^(2 - p0) - 1) / (2 - p0) - (u^(1 - p0) - 1) / (1 - p0))
      if (is.finite(i0) && i0 > 0 && is.finite(i1)) {
        mean_time_trunc <- i1 / i0
      }
    } else if (identical(round(p0, 12), 2.0)) {
      # Closed form limit at p = 2.
      i0 <- c0 * (1 - 1 / u)
      i1 <- c0^2 * (log(u) + (1 / u) - 1)
      if (is.finite(i0) && i0 > 0 && is.finite(i1)) {
        mean_time_trunc <- i1 / i0
      }
    }
    if (!is.finite(mean_time_trunc) || is.na(mean_time_trunc)) {
      num <- tryCatch(
        integrate(function(tt) tt * (1 + tt / c0)^(-p0), lower = 0, upper = ttr)$value,
        error = function(e) NA_real_
      )
      den <- tryCatch(
        integrate(function(tt) (1 + tt / c0)^(-p0), lower = 0, upper = ttr)$value,
        error = function(e) NA_real_
      )
      if (is.finite(num) && is.finite(den) && den > 0) {
        mean_time_trunc <- num / den
      }
    }
  }

  mean_scale <- if (is.finite(D0) && is.finite(g0) && !is.na(D0) && !is.na(g0)) {
    D0 * exp(g0 / b0)
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

  mean_distance <- if (is.finite(mean_scale) && !is.na(mean_scale) &&
                       is.finite(q0) && !is.na(q0) && q0 > 1.5) {
    sqrt(mean_scale) * (q0 - 1) * sqrt(pi) * gamma(q0 - 1.5) / gamma(q0)
  } else if (is.finite(q0) && !is.na(q0) && q0 <= 1.5) {
    Inf
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

  list(mean_time = mean_time, mean_time_trunc = mean_time_trunc, mean_distance = mean_distance, mean_scale = mean_scale)
}

get_sem_metric_trace <- function(fit_obj) {
  if (is.null(fit_obj)) return(NULL)
  sem_obj <- if (!is.null(fit_obj$fit) && !is.null(fit_obj$fit$adaptive)) {
    fit_obj$fit
  } else if (!is.null(fit_obj$sem) && !is.null(fit_obj$sem$adaptive)) {
    fit_obj$sem
  } else {
    NULL
  }
  if (is.null(sem_obj) || is.null(sem_obj$adaptive)) return(NULL)
  ad <- sem_obj$adaptive
  if (!is.null(ad$metrics) && length(ad$metrics) > 0) {
    return(as.numeric(ad$metrics))
  }
  # Backward compatibility: reconstruct selected metric per iter as max over proposal metrics.
  if (!is.null(ad$all_metrics) && length(ad$all_metrics) > 0) {
    vals <- vapply(ad$all_metrics, function(v) {
      if (is.null(v) || length(v) == 0) return(NA_real_)
      max(as.numeric(v), na.rm = TRUE)
    }, numeric(1))
    vals[is.infinite(vals)] <- NA_real_
    return(vals)
  }
  NULL
}

# Drop the left prefix of scale-breaking SEM jumps (C-lock / MAP teleport)
# so later variation is visible. Keep original iteration indices.
sem_first_kept_iter <- function(y, frac = 0.10, range_keep = 0.25,
                                min_keep = 8L, early_frac = 0.2) {
  y <- as.numeric(y)
  n <- length(y)
  if (n < 3L) return(1L)
  finite <- is.finite(y)
  if (sum(finite) < 3L) return(1L)
  span <- diff(range(y[finite], na.rm = TRUE))
  final <- y[max(which(finite))]
  thresh <- if (is.finite(span) && span > 0) frac * span else Inf
  min_keep <- min(as.integer(min_keep), n)
  max_drop <- n - min_keep
  i <- 1L
  early_n <- max(2L, min(n - min_keep, ceiling(early_frac * n)))
  if (is.finite(thresh) && early_n >= 1L) {
    early_idx <- seq_len(early_n)
    early_idx <- early_idx[is.finite(y[early_idx])]
    if (length(early_idx)) {
      worst <- early_idx[which.max(abs(y[early_idx] - final))]
      if (abs(y[worst] - final) > thresh) i <- max(i, as.integer(worst) + 1L)
    }
  }
  i <- min(i, max_drop + 1L)
  while (i <= max_drop) {
    if (!is.finite(y[i])) { i <- i + 1L; next }
    if (is.finite(thresh) && abs(y[i] - final) > thresh) { i <- i + 1L; next }
    break
  }
  while (i <= max_drop) {
    rest <- y[i:n]
    rest <- rest[is.finite(rest)]
    rest2 <- y[(i + 1L):n]
    rest2 <- rest2[is.finite(rest2)]
    if (length(rest) < 2L || length(rest2) < 1L) break
    r1 <- diff(range(rest))
    r2 <- diff(range(rest2))
    if (is.finite(r1) && r1 > 0 && is.finite(r2) && (r2 / r1) < range_keep) {
      i <- i + 1L
      next
    }
    break
  }
  as.integer(i)
}

drop_sem_scale_prefix <- function(df, value_col, iter_col = "Iteration",
                                  group_cols = NULL) {
  if (is.null(df) || !is.data.frame(df) || nrow(df) < 1L) return(df)
  if (!value_col %in% names(df) || !iter_col %in% names(df)) return(df)
  if (is.null(group_cols)) {
    group_cols <- intersect(c("Model", "Metric", "entry"), names(df))
  }
  group_cols <- intersect(group_cols, names(df))
  split_keys <- if (length(group_cols)) {
    interaction(df[group_cols], drop = TRUE, lex.order = TRUE)
  } else {
    rep("all", nrow(df))
  }
  parts <- split(df, split_keys, drop = TRUE)
  out <- lapply(parts, function(d) {
    d <- d[order(as.numeric(d[[iter_col]])), , drop = FALSE]
    keep_from <- sem_first_kept_iter(d[[value_col]])
    if (keep_from > 1L && keep_from <= nrow(d)) {
      d <- d[seq.int(keep_from, nrow(d)), , drop = FALSE]
    }
    d
  })
  do.call(rbind, out)
}

get_sem_proposal_trace <- function(fit_obj) {
  if (is.null(fit_obj)) return(NULL)
  sem_obj <- if (!is.null(fit_obj$fit) && !is.null(fit_obj$fit$adaptive)) {
    fit_obj$fit
  } else if (!is.null(fit_obj$sem) && !is.null(fit_obj$sem$adaptive)) {
    fit_obj$sem
  } else {
    NULL
  }
  if (is.null(sem_obj) || is.null(sem_obj$adaptive$all_metrics)) return(NULL)
  am <- sem_obj$adaptive$all_metrics
  rows <- lapply(seq_along(am), function(i) {
    v <- as.numeric(am[[i]])
    if (!length(v)) return(NULL)
    data.frame(Iteration = i, Proposal = seq_along(v), LogLik = v)
  })
  rows <- Filter(Negate(is.null), rows)
  if (!length(rows)) return(NULL)
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}
```

```{r tbl-params}
#| label: tbl-params
beta_proxy <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(unlist(cfg$BETA_GR, use.names = FALSE)))
beta_proxy <- beta_proxy[is.finite(beta_proxy)]
beta_proxy <- if (length(beta_proxy) > 0) beta_proxy[[1]] else 2.3

eta_exact <- function(mu, A, alpha_m, beta_gr = beta_proxy) {
  if (!all(is.finite(c(mu, A, alpha_m, beta_gr))) || beta_gr <= 0) return(NA_real_)
  if (alpha_m >= beta_gr) return(Inf)
  A * beta_gr / (beta_gr - alpha_m)
}

param_rows <- do.call(rbind, lapply(param_models, function(m) {
  mu_c <- bc(m$par, "mu"); A_c <- bc(m$par, "A"); a_c <- bc(m$par, "alpha_m")
  mu_t <- bt(m$par, "mu"); A_t <- bt(m$par, "A"); a_t <- bt(m$par, "alpha_m")
  eta_c <- eta_exact(mu_c, A_c, a_c)
  eta_t <- eta_exact(mu_t, A_t, a_t)
  rbind(
    data.frame(
      Fit = m$long, Process = "Control",
      mu = mu_c, A = A_c, alpha_m = a_c,
      branch_proxy = eta_c,
      mu_branch_proxy = if (is.finite(mu_c) && is.finite(eta_c)) mu_c * eta_c else NA_real_,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ),
    data.frame(
      Fit = m$long, Process = "Treated",
      mu = mu_t, A = A_t, alpha_m = a_t,
      branch_proxy = eta_t,
      mu_branch_proxy = if (is.finite(mu_t) && is.finite(eta_t)) mu_t * eta_t else NA_real_,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  )
}))
```

## SEM Convergence

```{r fig-flips}
#| label: fig-flips
#| fig-cap: "Accepted SEM confusion-matrix entry counts by inner iteration (county SEM fits). The initial scale-breaking MAP/C-lock jump is omitted so later 1-count changes are visible; each entry has its own y-scale."
#| fig-height: 8
extract_selected_confusion_trace <- function(sem_obj, model_label) {
  ad <- sem_obj$fit$adaptive
  if (is.null(ad) || is.null(ad$class_results) || is.null(ad$all_metrics)) return(NULL)
  if (length(ad$class_results) < 1 || length(ad$all_metrics) < 1) return(NULL)

  offset <- 0L
  rows <- list()
  for (i in seq_along(ad$all_metrics)) {
    metric_i <- ad$all_metrics[[i]]
    n_i <- length(metric_i)
    if (n_i < 1L) next
    best_j <- which.max(as.numeric(metric_i))
    class_idx <- offset + best_j
    if (class_idx > length(ad$class_results)) break
    cm <- ad$class_results[[class_idx]]
    if (is.null(cm)) {
      offset <- offset + n_i
      next
    }
    rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
      iteration = i,
      Model = model_label,
      control_as_control = as.numeric(if (!is.null(cm$control_as_control)) cm$control_as_control else 0),
      control_as_treated = as.numeric(if (!is.null(cm$control_as_treated)) cm$control_as_treated else 0),
      treated_as_control = as.numeric(if (!is.null(cm$treated_as_control)) cm$treated_as_control else 0),
      treated_as_treated = as.numeric(if (!is.null(cm$treated_as_treated)) cm$treated_as_treated else 0)
    )
    offset <- offset + n_i
  }
  if (length(rows) < 1L) return(NULL)
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}

trace_rows <- list()
sem_fit_convergence <- list(
  list(obj = if (!is.null(fit_B_obj)) fit_B_obj$fit else NULL, lab = "B: SEM Biv"),
  list(obj = if (!is.null(fit_D_obj)) fit_D_obj$fit else NULL, lab = "D: SEM Biv+KDE (all-free)"),
  list(obj = if (!is.null(fit_F_obj)) fit_F_obj$fit else NULL, lab = "F: SEM Biv+KDE (struct-fixed)"),
  list(obj = if (!is.null(fit_H_obj)) fit_H_obj$fit else NULL, lab = "H: SEM Univ+KDE"),
  list(obj = if (!is.null(fit_J_obj)) fit_J_obj$fit else NULL, lab = "J: SEM Univ (no KDE)")
)
for (nm in sem_fit_convergence) {
  if (is.null(nm$obj) || is.null(nm$obj$adaptive)) next
  trace_df <- extract_selected_confusion_trace(
    list(fit = nm$obj),
    nm$lab
  )
  if (!is.null(trace_df) && nrow(trace_df) > 0) {
    trace_rows[[length(trace_rows) + 1L]] <- trace_df
  } 
}

if (length(trace_rows) > 0) {
  trace_df <- do.call(rbind, trace_rows)
  trace_long <- tidyr::pivot_longer(
    trace_df,
    cols = c(control_as_control, control_as_treated, treated_as_control, treated_as_treated),
    names_to = "entry",
    values_to = "count"
  )
  trace_long$entry <- factor(
    trace_long$entry,
    levels = c("control_as_control", "control_as_treated", "treated_as_control", "treated_as_treated"),
    labels = c("Control -> Control", "Control -> Treated", "Treated -> Control", "Treated -> Treated")
  )
  trace_long <- drop_sem_scale_prefix(trace_long, value_col = "count", iter_col = "iteration")
}
if (length(trace_rows) > 0 && !is.null(trace_long) && nrow(trace_long) > 0) {
  ggplot(trace_long, aes(x = iteration, y = count, colour = entry)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
    facet_grid(entry ~ Model, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_color_manual(name = "Confusion entry", values = c(
      "Control -> Control" = "#1f78b4",
      "Control -> Treated" = "#e31a1c",
      "Treated -> Control" = "#ff7f00",
      "Treated -> Treated" = "#33a02c"
    )) +
    labs(x = "Iteration", y = "Count") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "none", strip.text.y = element_text(size = 8))
} else {
  plot.new()
  text(0.5, 0.5, "No SEM confusion-matrix trace found for county SEM fits (B/D/F/H/J).")
}
```

```{r fig-sem-adaptive-loglik}
#| label: fig-sem-adaptive-loglik
#| fig-cap: "Adaptive SEM selected-proposal score (solid) after omitting the initial scale-breaking MAP/C-lock jump. Grey points are other proposals in the same zoom window. Running best is dashed."
#| fig-height: 4.5
sem_metric_rows <- list()
sem_prop_rows <- list()
for (info in list(
  list(obj = fit_B_obj, lab = "B: SEM Biv"),
  list(obj = fit_D_obj, lab = "D: SEM Biv+KDE (all-free)"),
  list(obj = fit_F_obj, lab = "F: SEM Biv+KDE (struct-fixed)"),
  list(obj = fit_H_obj, lab = "H: SEM Univ+KDE"),
  list(obj = fit_J_obj, lab = "J: SEM Univ (no KDE)")
)) {
  tr <- get_sem_metric_trace(info$obj)
  if (!is.null(tr) && length(tr) > 0) {
    sem_metric_rows[[length(sem_metric_rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      Iteration = seq_along(tr),
      LogLik = as.numeric(tr),
      Model = info$lab
    )
  }
  pr <- get_sem_proposal_trace(info$obj)
  if (!is.null(pr) && nrow(pr) > 0) {
    pr$Model <- info$lab
    sem_prop_rows[[length(sem_prop_rows) + 1]] <- pr
  }
}
if (length(sem_metric_rows) > 0) {
  sem_metric_df <- do.call(rbind, sem_metric_rows)
  sem_metric_df <- sem_metric_df[is.finite(sem_metric_df$LogLik), , drop = FALSE]
  sem_metric_df <- drop_sem_scale_prefix(sem_metric_df, value_col = "LogLik")
}
if (length(sem_metric_rows) > 0 && !is.null(sem_metric_df) && nrow(sem_metric_df) > 0) {
  sem_metric_df <- sem_metric_df |>
    dplyr::group_by(.data$Model) |>
    dplyr::arrange(.data$Iteration, .by_group = TRUE) |>
    dplyr::mutate(RunningBest = cummax(.data$LogLik)) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()
  sem_metric_last <- sem_metric_df |>
    dplyr::group_by(.data$Model) |>
    dplyr::filter(.data$Iteration == max(.data$Iteration, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
    dplyr::slice_tail(n = 1) |>
    dplyr::ungroup() |>
    dplyr::mutate(lbl = sprintf("final = %.2f", .data$LogLik))
  sem_prop_zoom <- NULL
  if (length(sem_prop_rows) > 0) {
    sem_prop_df <- do.call(rbind, sem_prop_rows)
    kept <- unique(sem_metric_df[, c("Model", "Iteration")])
    sem_prop_df <- merge(sem_prop_df, kept, by = c("Model", "Iteration"))
    lims <- sem_metric_df |>
      dplyr::group_by(.data$Model) |>
      dplyr::summarise(
        ymin = min(.data$LogLik, na.rm = TRUE),
        ymax = max(.data$LogLik, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        pad = pmax(0.08 * (.data$ymax - .data$ymin), 0.2),
        ymin = .data$ymin - .data$pad,
        ymax = .data$ymax + .data$pad
      )
    sem_prop_df <- merge(sem_prop_df, lims, by = "Model")
    sem_prop_zoom <- sem_prop_df[
      is.finite(sem_prop_df$LogLik) &
        sem_prop_df$LogLik >= sem_prop_df$ymin &
        sem_prop_df$LogLik <= sem_prop_df$ymax,
      , drop = FALSE
    ]
  }
  p_ll <- ggplot(sem_metric_df, aes(x = Iteration, y = LogLik, colour = Model))
  if (!is.null(sem_prop_zoom) && nrow(sem_prop_zoom) > 0) {
    p_ll <- p_ll + geom_point(
      data = sem_prop_zoom,
      aes(x = Iteration, y = LogLik),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      alpha = 0.18, size = 0.55, colour = "grey30"
    )
  }
  p_ll +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_line(aes(y = RunningBest), linewidth = 0.7, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_text(
      data = sem_metric_last,
      aes(x = Inf, y = -Inf, label = lbl),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      hjust = 1.05, vjust = -0.4, size = 3.2, colour = "black"
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(
      "B: SEM Biv" = "#6a3d9a",
      "D: SEM Biv+KDE (all-free)" = "#e31a1c",
      "F: SEM Biv+KDE (struct-fixed)" = "#1f78b4",
      "H: SEM Univ+KDE" = "#ff7f00",
      "J: SEM Univ (no KDE)" = "#b8860b"
    )) +
    labs(x = "Adaptive SEM iteration", y = "Selected SEM score (solid) / running best (dashed)") +
    facet_wrap(~Model, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
} else {
  plot.new()
  text(0.5, 0.5, "No adaptive SEM log-likelihood trace found in this results file.")
}
```

```{r fig-sem-cumulative-flips}
#| label: fig-sem-cumulative-flips
#| fig-cap: "Per-iteration SEM label flips after omitting the initial MAP Hamming spike. Average and accepted flips have separate y-scales so later 0–2 flip noise is visible."
#| fig-height: 6
flip_rows <- list()
for (info in list(
  list(obj = fit_B_obj, lab = "B: SEM Biv"),
  list(obj = fit_D_obj, lab = "D: SEM Biv+KDE (all-free)"),
  list(obj = fit_F_obj, lab = "F: SEM Biv+KDE (struct-fixed)"),
  list(obj = fit_H_obj, lab = "H: SEM Univ+KDE"),
  list(obj = fit_J_obj, lab = "J: SEM Univ (no KDE)")
)) {
  ad <- if (!is.null(info$obj)) info$obj$fit$adaptive else NULL
  if (is.null(ad) || is.null(ad$average_flips) || is.null(ad$max_metric_flips)) next
  n <- min(length(ad$average_flips), length(ad$max_metric_flips))
  if (n < 1) next
  tmp <- data.frame(
    Iteration = seq_len(n),
    Model = info$lab,
    AverageFlips = as.numeric(ad$average_flips[seq_len(n)]),
    AcceptedFlips = as.numeric(ad$max_metric_flips[seq_len(n)])
  )
  flip_rows[[length(flip_rows) + 1]] <- tmp
}
if (length(flip_rows) > 0) {
  flip_df <- do.call(rbind, flip_rows)
  flip_df <- flip_df |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = c(AverageFlips, AcceptedFlips),
      names_to = "Metric",
      values_to = "Flips"
    )
  flip_df$Metric <- factor(
    flip_df$Metric,
    levels = c("AverageFlips", "AcceptedFlips"),
    labels = c("Average flips", "Accepted flips")
  )
  flip_df <- drop_sem_scale_prefix(flip_df, value_col = "Flips")
}
if (length(flip_rows) > 0 && !is.null(flip_df) && nrow(flip_df) > 0) {
  ggplot(flip_df, aes(x = Iteration, y = Flips, colour = Metric)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
    facet_grid(Metric ~ Model, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c(
      "Average flips" = "#08519c",
      "Accepted flips" = "#a50f15"
    )) +
    labs(x = "Adaptive SEM iteration", y = "Flips per iteration") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")
} else {
  plot.new()
  text(0.5, 0.5, "No SEM flip traces found in this results file.")
}
```

## SEM Relabelling Summary

```{r tbl-cm-summary}
#| label: tbl-cm-summary
build_cm <- function(sem_obj) {
  if (is.null(sem_obj)) return(NULL)
  lab <- sem_obj$adaptive$adaptive_labelling
  post <- lab[lab$t >= 0, ]
  if (is.null(post$location_process) || is.null(post$inferred_process)) return(NULL)
  tab <- table(Location = post$location_process, Inferred = post$inferred_process)
  as.data.frame.matrix(tab)
}

sem_fit_obj <- function(obj) {
  if (is.null(obj)) return(NULL)
  if (!is.null(obj$fit) && !is.null(obj$fit$adaptive)) return(obj$fit)
  if (!is.null(obj$sem) && !is.null(obj$sem$adaptive)) return(obj$sem)
  if (!is.null(obj$adaptive)) return(obj)
  obj$fit %||% obj$sem %||% NULL
}

cm_specs <- list(
  list(cm = build_cm(sem_fit_obj(fit_B_obj)), lab = "B: SEM Bivariate (homogeneous)"),
  list(cm = build_cm(sem_fit_obj(fit_D_obj)), lab = "D: SEM Bivariate+KDE (all-free)"),
  list(cm = build_cm(sem_fit_obj(fit_F_obj)), lab = "F: SEM Bivariate+KDE (struct-fixed)"),
  list(cm = build_cm(sem_fit_obj(fit_H_obj)), lab = "H: SEM Univariate+KDE"),
  list(cm = build_cm(sem_fit_obj(fit_J_obj)), lab = "J: SEM Univariate (homogeneous)")
)

sum_rows <- list()
for (info in cm_specs) {
  cm <- info$cm
  if (is.null(cm)) next
  n_total <- sum(cm)
  ctrl_to_treat <- if ("treated" %in% colnames(cm) && "control" %in% rownames(cm)) {
    cm["control", "treated"]
  } else {
    0
  }
  treat_to_ctrl <- if ("control" %in% colnames(cm) && "treated" %in% rownames(cm)) {
    cm["treated", "control"]
  } else {
    0
  }
  n_flipped <- ctrl_to_treat + treat_to_ctrl
  sum_rows[[length(sum_rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
    Model = info$lab,
    `Post events` = n_total,
    `Ctrl to Treat` = ctrl_to_treat,
    `Treat to Ctrl` = treat_to_ctrl,
    `Total relabelled` = n_flipped,
    `Pct relabelled` = paste0(round(n_flipped / n_total * 100, 1), "%"),
    check.names = FALSE
  )
}
if (length(sum_rows) > 0) {
  kable(do.call(rbind, sum_rows),
        caption = "Summary of SEM relabelling for all county SEM fits (B, D, F, H, J).",
        align = "lccccc") |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)
} else {
  cat("No SEM relabelling summaries available.\n")
}
```

```{r tbl-ate-helpers}
get_total_effect_sim <- function(ate_obj, n_tiles = n_cty) {
  if (is.null(ate_obj) || is.null(ate_obj$all_nothing_sim)) return(NULL)
  if (!is.finite(n_tiles) || is.na(n_tiles) || n_tiles < 1) n_tiles <- 1
  sim_df <- ate_obj$all_nothing_sim
  if ("total_saved" %in% names(sim_df)) return(sim_df$total_saved)
  if ("total_effect" %in% names(sim_df)) return(sim_df$total_effect)
  sim_df$ATE * n_tiles
}

get_expected_totals <- function(ate_obj, n_tiles = n_cty) {
  if (is.null(ate_obj) || is.null(ate_obj$all_nothing_sim)) return(NULL)
  sim_df <- ate_obj$all_nothing_sim
  if (all(c("c_total", "t_total") %in% names(sim_df))) {
    return(list(c_total = sim_df$c_total, t_total = sim_df$t_total))
  }
  list(c_total = sim_df$c_mean * n_tiles, t_total = sim_df$t_mean * n_tiles)
}

paper_ok_counts_row <- function(method_label, ate_obj, estimand_label = NA_character_) {
  expected <- tryCatch(get_expected_totals(ate_obj, n_tiles = n_cty), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(expected)) return(NULL)
  c_mean <- mean(expected$c_total, na.rm = TRUE)
  t_mean <- mean(expected$t_total, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(c_mean) || !is.finite(t_mean)) return(NULL)
  data.frame(
    Method = method_label,
    Estimand = estimand_label,
    `E[N(control)]` = round(c_mean, 0),
    `E[N(right)]` = round(t_mean, 0),
    `Delta = control - right` = round(c_mean - t_mean, 0),
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}
pick_ate_contrast_early <- function(ate_obj, contrast = c("all_or_nothing", "observed")) {
  contrast <- match.arg(contrast)
  if (is.null(ate_obj)) return(NULL)
  bc <- ate_obj$by_contrast
  if (is.list(bc) && !is.null(bc[[contrast]])) return(bc[[contrast]])
  if (!is.null(ate_obj$contrast) && identical(as.character(ate_obj$contrast)[1], contrast)) {
    return(ate_obj)
  }
  if (identical(contrast, "all_or_nothing") && !is.null(ate_obj$all_nothing_sim)) {
    return(ate_obj)
  }
  NULL
}
```

```{r tbl-ate-biv}
model_label_by_id <- function(id) {
  switch(
    toupper(id),
    "C" = "C: Naive Biv+KDE (all-free)",
    "D" = "D: SEM Biv+KDE (all-free)",
    "E" = "E: Naive Biv+KDE (struct-fixed)",
    "F" = "F: SEM Biv+KDE (struct-fixed)",
    paste0(id, ": model")
  )

get_boot_df <- function(id) {
  if (is.null(boot_obj)) return(NULL)
  stable_rows <- function(df) {
    df <- as.data.frame(df)
    if ("is_stable" %in% names(df)) {
      df <- df[!is.na(df$is_stable) & df$is_stable, , drop = FALSE]
    }
    df
  }
  key <- paste0("fit_", toupper(id))
  if (!is.null(boot_obj[[key]]) &&
      !is.null(boot_obj[[key]]$replicate_summary) &&
      nrow(boot_obj[[key]]$replicate_summary) > 0) {
    return(stable_rows(boot_obj[[key]]$replicate_summary))
  }
  # Cross-alias: legacy primary stored under fit_E/fit_F maps to C/D.
  alias <- switch(toupper(id), "C" = "fit_E", "D" = "fit_F", NA_character_)
  if (is.character(alias) && !is.na(alias) &&
      !is.null(boot_obj[[alias]]) &&
      !is.null(boot_obj[[alias]]$replicate_summary) &&
      nrow(boot_obj[[alias]]$replicate_summary) > 0) {
    return(stable_rows(boot_obj[[alias]]$replicate_summary))
  }
  NULL
}
boot_naive_id <- boot_primary_ids[[1]]

boot_sem_df <- get_boot_df(boot_sem_id)

# Explosive refits are removed in the analysis pipeline before these summaries.
# Retain every finite ATE from the stable remainder; do not apply an ATE-tail
# filter, because a large but stable estimate is part of parameter uncertainty.
retain_boot_vals <- function(x) {
  x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  ok <- is.finite(x)
  list(
    vals = x[ok],
    n_in = length(x),
    n_out = as.integer(sum(!ok)),
    dropped = x[!ok]
  )
}

get_boot_summary <- function(model_label) {
  vals <- NULL
  if (model_label == boot_naive_label && !is.null(boot_naive_df)) vals <- boot_naive_df$ate_total_mean
  if (model_label == boot_sem_label && !is.null(boot_sem_df)) vals <- boot_sem_df$ate_total_mean
  # Compatibility fallback if table labels differ from selected pair labels.
  if (is.null(vals) && model_label == "C: Naive Biv+KDE (all-free)" && !is.null(get_boot_df("C"))) vals <- get_boot_df("C")$ate_total_mean
  if (is.null(vals) && model_label == "D: SEM Biv+KDE (all-free)" && !is.null(get_boot_df("D"))) vals <- get_boot_df("D")$ate_total_mean
  if (is.null(vals)) return(NULL)
  vals <- retain_boot_vals(vals)$vals
  if (length(vals) < 2) return(NULL)
  list(
    sd = stats::sd(vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    lo = as.numeric(stats::quantile(vals, probs = 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
    hi = as.numeric(stats::quantile(vals, probs = 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)),
    n = length(vals),
    vals = vals
  )
}

boot_ci_efron_bc <- function(boot_vals, theta_hat, conf = 0.95) {
  x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(boot_vals))
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  theta_hat <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(theta_hat))
  if (length(x) < 5L || !is.finite(theta_hat) || is.na(theta_hat)) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  alpha <- (1 - conf) / 2
  q_pct <- stats::quantile(x, probs = c(alpha, 1 - alpha), na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE)
  p_less <- mean(x < theta_hat, na.rm = TRUE)
  # Guard against p=0 or p=1 leading to infinite z0.
  eps <- 1 / (length(x) + 1)
  p_less <- min(max(p_less, eps), 1 - eps)
  z0 <- stats::qnorm(p_less)
  z_lo <- stats::qnorm(alpha)
  z_hi <- stats::qnorm(1 - alpha)
  a_lo <- stats::pnorm(2 * z0 + z_lo)
  a_hi <- stats::pnorm(2 * z0 + z_hi)
  a_lo <- min(max(a_lo, eps), 1 - eps)
  a_hi <- min(max(a_hi, eps), 1 - eps)
  if (a_lo > a_hi) {
    tmp <- a_lo; a_lo <- a_hi; a_hi <- tmp
  }
  # If BC collapses to a numerically degenerate interval, use percentile fallback.
  if (!is.finite(a_lo) || !is.finite(a_hi) || is.na(a_lo) || is.na(a_hi) ||
      (a_hi - a_lo) < (1 / length(x))) {
    return(list(
      lo = as.numeric(q_pct[[1]]),
      hi = as.numeric(q_pct[[2]]),
      z0 = z0,
      p_less = p_less,
      alpha_lo = alpha,
      alpha_hi = 1 - alpha,
      method = "percentile_fallback"
    ))
  }
  lo <- as.numeric(stats::quantile(x, probs = a_lo, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE))
  hi <- as.numeric(stats::quantile(x, probs = a_hi, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE))
  list(lo = lo, hi = hi, z0 = z0, p_less = p_less, alpha_lo = a_lo, alpha_hi = a_hi, method = "bc")
}

boot_ci_quantile_length <- function(boot_vals, theta_hat, conf = 0.95, center_stat = c("median", "mean")) {
  center_stat <- match.arg(center_stat)
  x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(boot_vals))
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  theta_hat <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(theta_hat))
  if (length(x) < 5L || !is.finite(theta_hat) || is.na(theta_hat)) return(NULL)
  alpha <- (1 - conf) / 2
  q_lo <- as.numeric(stats::quantile(x, probs = alpha, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE))
  q_hi <- as.numeric(stats::quantile(x, probs = 1 - alpha, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE))
  center <- if (identical(center_stat, "median")) stats::median(x, na.rm = TRUE) else mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(q_lo) || !is.finite(q_hi) || !is.finite(center)) return(NULL)
  left_len <- center - q_lo
  right_len <- q_hi - center
  if (!is.finite(left_len) || !is.finite(right_len)) return(NULL)
  list(
    lo = theta_hat - left_len,
    hi = theta_hat + right_len,
    q_lo = q_lo,
    q_hi = q_hi,
    center = center
  )
}

format_partition_label <- function(part_id) {
  if (is.na(part_id) || is.null(part_id)) return(part_id)
  if (part_id == "county") return("County")
  if (part_id == "aoi_region") return("AOI region")
  if (part_id == "grid_coarse") return("Grid (coarse)")
  m <- regexec("^grid_([0-9.]+)R$", part_id)
  g <- regmatches(part_id, m)[[1]]
  if (length(g) == 2) {
    mult <- sub("\\.0$", "", g[2])
    return(paste0("Grid (", mult, "x triggering range)"))
  }
  part_id
}

# Prefer contrast-specific payload from $by_contrast when present (new dual-estimand runs).
pick_ate_contrast <- function(ate_obj, contrast = c("all_or_nothing", "observed")) {
  contrast <- match.arg(contrast)
  if (is.null(ate_obj)) return(NULL)
  bc <- ate_obj$by_contrast
  if (is.list(bc) && !is.null(bc[[contrast]])) return(bc[[contrast]])
  if (!is.null(ate_obj$contrast) && identical(as.character(ate_obj$contrast)[1], contrast)) {
    return(ate_obj)
  }
  # Legacy single-contrast objects: only reuse for all_or_nothing if sims are present.
  if (identical(contrast, "all_or_nothing") && !is.null(ate_obj$all_nothing_sim)) {
    return(ate_obj)
  }
  NULL
}

estimand_specs <- list(
  list(
    id = "all_or_nothing",
    label = "All-or-nothing",
    right_lab = "E[N(treated everywhere)]"
  ),
  list(
    id = "observed",
    label = "Observed vs control",
    right_lab = "E[N(actual treatment regime)]"
  )
)

ate_row_for <- function(r, est) {
  ate_use <- pick_ate_contrast(r$ate, est$id)
  if (is.null(ate_use)) return(NULL)
  expected <- tryCatch(get_expected_totals(ate_use, n_tiles = n_cty), error = function(e) NULL)
  sim_totals <- tryCatch(get_total_effect_sim(ate_use, n_tiles = n_cty), error = function(e) NULL)
  c_mean <- if (!is.null(expected) && !is.null(expected$c_total) && length(expected$c_total) > 0) {
    mean(expected$c_total, na.rm = TRUE)
  } else { NA_real_ }
  t_mean <- if (!is.null(expected) && !is.null(expected$t_total) && length(expected$t_total) > 0) {
    mean(expected$t_total, na.rm = TRUE)
  } else { NA_real_ }
  c_sd <- if (!is.null(expected) && !is.null(expected$c_total) && length(expected$c_total) > 1L) {
    sd(expected$c_total, na.rm = TRUE)
  } else { NA_real_ }
  t_sd <- if (!is.null(expected) && !is.null(expected$t_total) && length(expected$t_total) > 1L) {
    sd(expected$t_total, na.rm = TRUE)
  } else { NA_real_ }
  saved_diff_mean <- if (is.finite(c_mean) && is.finite(t_mean)) c_mean - t_mean else NA_real_
  sim_sd_total  <- if (!is.null(sim_totals) && length(sim_totals) > 1L) sd(sim_totals, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_
  base_row <- data.frame(
    Model = r$lab,
    Estimand = est$label,
    `Observed N(actual regime)` = obs_post_n,
    `E[N(control everywhere)]` = round(c_mean, 0),
    `E[N(right-hand regime)]` = round(t_mean, 0),
    `SD(control everywhere)` = round(c_sd, 0),
    `SD(right-hand regime)` = round(t_sd, 0),
    `Saved = control - right` = round(saved_diff_mean, 0),
    `SD(saved)` = round(sim_sd_total, 0),
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  if (using_pre_bootstrap) return(base_row)
  # Bootstrap uncertainty only for primary all-free pair (C/D) on the run's primary contrast.
  boot_models_for_table <- c("C: Naive Biv+KDE (all-free)", "D: SEM Biv+KDE (all-free)")
  primary_contrast <- tolower(as.character(cfg$ATE_CONTRAST %||% "all_or_nothing")[1])
  boot_sum <- if (r$lab %in% boot_models_for_table && identical(est$id, primary_contrast)) {
    get_boot_summary(r$lab)
  } else {
    NULL
  }
  boot_sd <- if (!is.null(boot_sum)) round(boot_sum$sd, 0) else NA
  boot_ci_q_len <- if (!is.null(boot_sum) && is.finite(saved_diff_mean)) {
    ci <- boot_ci_quantile_length(boot_sum$vals, saved_diff_mean, conf = 0.95, center_stat = "median")
    if (!is.null(ci) && is.finite(ci$lo) && is.finite(ci$hi)) {
      sprintf("[%d, %d]", round(ci$lo, 0), round(ci$hi, 0))
    } else {
      "NA"
    }
  } else {
    "NA"
  }
  base_row$`Bootstrap SD (ATE)` <- boot_sd
  base_row$`95% quantile-length CI` <- boot_ci_q_len
  base_row
}

ate_rows <- unlist(lapply(biv_rows, function(r) {
  lapply(estimand_specs, function(est) ate_row_for(r, est))
}), recursive = FALSE)
ate_rows <- Filter(Negate(is.null), ate_rows)
ate_biv <- if (length(ate_rows) > 0L) do.call(rbind, ate_rows) else NULL
if (!is.null(ate_biv) && nrow(ate_biv) > 0) {
  core_cols <- c(

  } else {

  kable(ate_biv,
        col.names = if (using_pre_bootstrap) {

            "Model", "Estimand",
            paste0("Observed N(actual regime) / ", ate_days, "d"),
            "E[N(control everywhere)]",
            "E[N(right-hand regime)]",
            "SD(control everywhere)", "SD(right-hand regime)",
            paste0("Saved = control - right / ", n_cty, " tiles / ", ate_days, "d"),

          )
        } else {

            "E[N(right-hand regime)]",

            paste0("Saved = control - right / ", n_cty, " tiles / ", ate_days, "d"),

}
```

### Combined parameter comparison (all fits A–J)

```{r tbl-params-all-fits}
#| label: tbl-params-all-fits
# Unified A–J comparison only (pair-wise tables removed).
# Bivariate fits use shared structural (c,p,D,q); univariate fits map A_k -> A_kk,
# leave cross channels blank, and keep margin-specific structural terms.
to_named_num <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x)) return(setNames(numeric(0), character(0)))
  if (is.list(x)) x <- unlist(x, use.names = TRUE)
  v <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  nms <- names(x)
  if (is.null(nms)) nms <- rep("", length(v))
  names(v) <- nms
  v
}
beta_gr_tbl <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(unlist(cfg$BETA_GR, use.names = FALSE)))
beta_gr_tbl <- beta_gr_tbl[is.finite(beta_gr_tbl) & beta_gr_tbl > 0]
beta_gr_tbl <- if (length(beta_gr_tbl)) beta_gr_tbl[[1]] else 2.3
etas_branch_matrix <- function(par, beta_gr) {
  getp <- function(nm) {
    v <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(par[[nm]]))
    if (!length(v) || !is.finite(v[[1]])) return(NA_real_)
    v[[1]]
  }
  eta_ij <- function(A, alpha) {
    if (!is.finite(A) || !is.finite(alpha) || !is.finite(beta_gr) || beta_gr <= 0) return(NA_real_)
    gap <- beta_gr - alpha
    if (!is.finite(gap) || gap <= 1e-8) return(Inf)
    A * beta_gr / gap
  }
  matrix(
    c(
      eta_ij(getp("A_00"), getp("alpha_m_00")),
      eta_ij(getp("A_01"), getp("alpha_m_01")),
      eta_ij(getp("A_10"), getp("alpha_m_10")),
      eta_ij(getp("A_11"), getp("alpha_m_11"))
    ),
    nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE,
    dimnames = list(c("from_0", "from_1"), c("to_0", "to_1"))
  )
}
spectral_radius_etas <- function(par, beta_gr) {
  M <- etas_branch_matrix(par, beta_gr)
  if (!all(is.finite(M))) return(Inf)
  max(Re(eigen(M, only.values = TRUE)$values))
}
univ_eta <- function(par, beta_gr) {
  if (is.null(par)) return(NA_real_)
  pv <- to_named_num(par)
  A <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(pv[["A"]]))
  alpha <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(pv[["alpha_m"]]))
  if (!length(A) || !length(alpha) || !is.finite(A[[1]]) || !is.finite(alpha[[1]]) ||
      !is.finite(beta_gr) || beta_gr <= 0) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  gap <- beta_gr - alpha[[1]]
  if (!is.finite(gap) || gap <= 1e-8) return(Inf)
  A[[1]] * beta_gr / gap
}
extract_univ_margin <- function(fit_obj, margin) {
  if (is.null(fit_obj) || is.null(fit_obj$params)) return(NULL)
  p <- fit_obj$params
  if (!is.null(p[[margin]])) return(p[[margin]])
  NULL
}
fmt_sigfig_all <- function(x, digits = 3L) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) < 1L || is.na(x)) return("—")
  if (!is.finite(x)) return("Inf")
  v <- signif(as.numeric(x), digits)
  if (!is.finite(v) || v == 0) return(format(v, scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE))
  order <- floor(log10(abs(v)))
  dp <- max(0L, as.integer(digits) - order - 1L)
  sprintf(paste0("%.", dp, "f"), v)
}
pull_num <- function(par, nm) {
  if (is.null(par)) return(NA_real_)
  v <- to_named_num(par)
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(v[[nm]]))
}
biv_col <- function(fit_obj) {
  p <- to_named_num(if (!is.null(fit_obj)) fit_obj$params else NULL)
  if (!length(p)) return(NULL)
  list(
    kind = "biv",
    p = p,
    rho = spectral_radius_etas(p, beta_gr_tbl)
  )
}
univ_col <- function(fit_obj) {
  ctrl <- extract_univ_margin(fit_obj, "control")
  treat <- extract_univ_margin(fit_obj, "treated")
  if (is.null(ctrl) && is.null(treat)) return(NULL)
  eta0 <- univ_eta(ctrl, beta_gr_tbl)
  eta1 <- univ_eta(treat, beta_gr_tbl)
  rho <- max(c(eta0, eta1), na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(rho)) rho <- Inf
  list(kind = "univ", ctrl = ctrl, treat = treat, rho = rho)
}
fit_cols <- list(
  A = biv_col(fit_A_obj), B = biv_col(fit_B_obj),
  C = biv_col(fit_C_obj), D = biv_col(fit_D_obj),
  E = biv_col(fit_E_obj), F = biv_col(fit_F_obj),
  G = univ_col(fit_G_obj), H = univ_col(fit_H_obj),
  I = univ_col(fit_I_obj), J = univ_col(fit_J_obj)
)
param_rows_all <- c(
  "mu_0", "mu_1",
  "A_00", "alpha_m_00", "A_11", "alpha_m_11",
  "A_01", "alpha_m_01", "A_10", "alpha_m_10",
  "c_0", "p_0", "D_0", "q_0",
  "c_1", "p_1", "D_1", "q_1",
  "rho", "explosive?"
)
val_for <- function(col, nm) {
  if (is.null(col)) return(NA_real_)
  if (identical(nm, "rho")) return(col$rho)
  if (identical(nm, "explosive?")) {
    return(if (!is.finite(col$rho)) Inf else if (col$rho >= 1) 1 else 0)
  }
  if (identical(col$kind, "biv")) {
    base <- sub("_[01]$", "", nm)
    if (grepl("^[cpDq]_", nm) || nm %in% c("c", "p", "D", "q")) {
      # Shared structural under bivariate law.
      return(pull_num(col$p, base))
    }
    return(pull_num(col$p, nm))
  }
  # univariate
  if (grepl("_0$", nm)) {
    return(pull_num(col$ctrl, sub("_0$", "", nm)))
  }
  if (grepl("_1$", nm)) {
    return(pull_num(col$treat, sub("_1$", "", nm)))
  }
  if (grepl("_(00|11)$", nm)) {
    margin <- if (grepl("_00$", nm)) col$ctrl else col$treat
    return(pull_num(margin, sub("_[01]{2}$", "", nm)))
  }
  # Cross channels absent under independent margins.
  if (grepl("_(01|10)$", nm)) return(NA_real_)
  NA_real_
}
fmt_cell <- function(col, nm) {
  if (identical(nm, "explosive?")) {
    if (is.null(col)) return("—")
    if (!is.finite(col$rho)) return("yes (Inf)")
    if (col$rho >= 1) "yes" else "no"
  } else {
    fmt_sigfig_all(val_for(col, nm), 3L)
  }
}
present_letters <- names(fit_cols)[vapply(fit_cols, function(z) !is.null(z), logical(1))]
if (length(present_letters) > 0L) {
  all_mat <- sapply(present_letters, function(let) {
    vapply(param_rows_all, function(nm) fmt_cell(fit_cols[[let]], nm), character(1))
  }, simplify = "matrix")
  if (is.null(dim(all_mat))) {
    all_mat <- matrix(all_mat, ncol = 1, dimnames = list(param_rows_all, present_letters))
  }
  all_tbl <- data.frame(Parameter = param_rows_all, all_mat, check.names = FALSE)
  kable(
    all_tbl,
    caption = paste0(
      "Combined ETAS parameter comparison across available fits A–J ",
      "(gamma fixed at 0). Bivariate columns share structural (c,p,D,q) across margins; ",
      "univariate columns leave cross-excitation (A_01/A_10) blank and report margin-specific ",
      "structural terms. rho is the offspring spectral radius (bivariate) or max margin branching ",
      "(univariate); explosive means rho >= 1 (beta=", signif(beta_gr_tbl, 3), ")."
    ),
    align = paste0("l", paste(rep("c", length(present_letters)), collapse = ""))
  ) |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "bordered"), full_width = FALSE) |>
    scroll_box(width = "100%", height = "640px")
} else {
  cat("Combined A–J parameter table unavailable in this results checkpoint.\n")
}
```

```{r fig-ate-biv}
#| label: fig-ate-biv
#| fig-cap: "Simulation distribution of the all-or-nothing total saved over the post-treatment horizon, facetted by model family with Naive vs SEM overlays."
#| fig-height: 4
biv_sim <- do.call(rbind, lapply(biv_rows, function(r) {
  if (is.null(r$ate)) return(NULL)
  data.frame(Model = r$lab, TotalATE = get_total_effect_sim(r$ate, n_tiles = n_cty))
}))
if (!is.null(biv_sim) && nrow(biv_sim) > 0) {
  assign_role <- function(model_label) {
    if (grepl("^A:|^C:|^E:", model_label)) return("Naive")
    if (grepl("^B:|^D:|^F:", model_label)) return("SEM")
    NA_character_
  }
  assign_pair <- function(model_label) {
    if (grepl("^A:|^B:", model_label)) return("Homogeneous (A/B)")
    if (grepl("^C:|^D:", model_label)) return("KDE all-free (C/D)")
    if (grepl("^E:|^F:", model_label)) return("KDE struct-fixed (E/F)")
    NA_character_
  }
  biv_sim$Role <- vapply(as.character(biv_sim$Model), assign_role, character(1))
  biv_sim$Pair <- vapply(as.character(biv_sim$Model), assign_pair, character(1))
  biv_sim <- biv_sim[!is.na(biv_sim$Role) & !is.na(biv_sim$Pair), , drop = FALSE]
  pair_ok <- vapply(split(biv_sim$Role, biv_sim$Pair), function(x) {
    all(c("Naive", "SEM") %in% unique(x))
  }, logical(1))
  biv_sim <- biv_sim[biv_sim$Pair %in% names(pair_ok)[pair_ok], , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(biv_sim) < 1L) {
    cat("Bivariate A–F ATE simulations are not in this results file.\n")
  } else {
    biv_sim$Role <- factor(biv_sim$Role, levels = c("Naive", "SEM"))
    biv_sim$Pair <- factor(
      biv_sim$Pair,
      levels = c("Homogeneous (A/B)", "KDE all-free (C/D)", "KDE struct-fixed (E/F)")
    )
    biv_means <- aggregate(TotalATE ~ Pair + Role, biv_sim, mean)
    ggplot(biv_sim, aes(x = TotalATE, fill = Role)) +
      geom_histogram(bins = 30, alpha = 0.55, position = "identity") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
      geom_vline(data = biv_means, aes(xintercept = TotalATE, colour = Role),
                 linetype = "solid", linewidth = 0.9, show.legend = FALSE) +
      facet_wrap(~Pair, scales = "free") +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c(Naive = "#fdb462", SEM = "#80b1d3")) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = c(Naive = "#e6550d", SEM = "#3182bd")) +
      labs(x = bquote(hat(Delta)[AoN] ~ "(total earthquakes saved /" ~ .(ate_days) ~ "days)"),
           y = "Simulation count",
           title = "All-or-Nothing Total Saved: Naive vs SEM by Model Family") +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
      theme(legend.position = "top",
            plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))
  }
} else {
  cat("Bivariate A–F ATE simulations are not in this results file.\n")
}
```
