```{r fig-ate-scenarios-4panel}
scen_primary_boot <- function(boot) {
  if (is.null(boot)) return(list(naive = NULL, sem = NULL))
  list(
    naive = if (!is.null(boot$fit_C)) boot$fit_C else boot$fit_E,
    sem = if (!is.null(boot$fit_D)) boot$fit_D else boot$fit_F
  )
}
scen_primary_fits <- function(fn) {
  if (is.null(fn)) return(list(naive = NULL, sem = NULL))
  list(
    naive = if (!is.null(fn$C)) fn$C else fn$E,
    sem = if (!is.null(fn$D)) fn$D else fn$F
  )
}
resolve_scen_file <- function(rel_files) {
  cands <- unique(unlist(lapply(c(OUT_DIR, candidate_out_dirs), function(d) {
    file.path(d, rel_files)
  }), use.names = FALSE))
  # Prefer the largest bootstrap n among existing candidates.
  existing <- cands[file.exists(cands)]
  if (!length(existing)) return(NA_character_)
  n_boot <- vapply(existing, function(f) {
    r <- tryCatch(normalize_oklahoma_fit_letters(readRDS(f)), error = function(e) NULL)
    blk <- scen_primary_boot(r$bootstrap_ate)$sem
    if (is.null(blk) || is.null(blk$replicate_summary)) return(0L)
    as.integer(nrow(blk$replicate_summary))
  }, integer(1))
  existing[[which.max(n_boot)]]
}
recenter_boot_scen <- function(boot_vals, target_mean) {
  bv <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(boot_vals))
  if (!is.finite(target_mean) || is.na(target_mean)) return(bv)
  bmean <- mean(bv, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(bmean) || is.na(bmean)) return(bv)
  bv + (target_mean - bmean)
}
point_mean_scen <- function(fit_obj) {
  if (is.null(fit_obj) || is.null(fit_obj$ate)) return(NA_real_)
  vals <- get_total_effect_sim(fit_obj$ate, n_tiles = n_cty)
  vals <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(vals))
  vals <- vals[is.finite(vals)]
  if (!length(vals)) return(NA_real_)
  mean(vals, na.rm = TRUE)
}
scen_boot_rows <- list()
scen_n_note <- character(0)
for (sp in scen_specs) {
  fp <- resolve_scen_file(sp$files)
  if (is.na(fp)) next
  rr <- tryCatch(normalize_oklahoma_fit_letters(readRDS(fp)), error = function(e) NULL)
  boot_pair <- scen_primary_boot(rr$bootstrap_ate)
  if (is.null(rr) || is.null(boot_pair$naive) || is.null(boot_pair$sem)) next
  be_df <- as.data.frame(boot_pair$naive$replicate_summary)
  bf_df <- as.data.frame(boot_pair$sem$replicate_summary)
  if ("is_stable" %in% names(be_df)) {
    be_df <- be_df[!is.na(be_df$is_stable) & be_df$is_stable, , drop = FALSE]
  }
  if ("is_stable" %in% names(bf_df)) {
    bf_df <- bf_df[!is.na(bf_df$is_stable) & bf_df$is_stable, , drop = FALSE]
  }
  be_raw <- be_df$ate_total_mean
  bf_raw <- bf_df$ate_total_mean
  fit_pair <- scen_primary_fits(rr$fits_named)
  pe <- point_mean_scen(fit_pair$naive)
  pf <- point_mean_scen(fit_pair$sem)
  be <- retain_boot_vals(be_raw)
  bf <- retain_boot_vals(bf_raw)
  attempted_C <- boot_pair$naive$n_attempted %||%
    rr$bootstrap_ate$config$reps %||% be$n_in
  attempted_D <- boot_pair$sem$n_attempted %||%
    rr$bootstrap_ate$config$reps %||% bf$n_in
  scen_n_note <- c(
    scen_n_note,
    sprintf(
      "%s retained C=%d/%d, D=%d/%d",
      sp$id, length(be$vals), attempted_C, length(bf$vals), attempted_D
    )
  )
  scen_boot_rows[[length(scen_boot_rows) + 1L]] <- rbind(
    data.frame(
      Law = sp$law, Contrast = sp$contrast, Model = "Naive (C)",
      TotalATE = recenter_boot_scen(be$vals, pe), stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ),
    data.frame(
      Law = sp$law, Contrast = sp$contrast, Model = "SEM (D)",
      TotalATE = recenter_boot_scen(bf$vals, pf), stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  )
}
if (length(scen_boot_rows) > 0) {
  scen_boot_df <- do.call(rbind, scen_boot_rows)
  scen_boot_df <- scen_boot_df[is.finite(scen_boot_df$TotalATE), , drop = FALSE]
  scen_boot_df$Law <- factor(scen_boot_df$Law, levels = c("Univariate", "Bivariate"))
  scen_boot_df$Contrast <- factor(scen_boot_df$Contrast, levels = c("All-or-nothing", "Observed vs control"))
  scen_boot_df$Model <- factor(scen_boot_df$Model, levels = c("Naive (C)", "SEM (D)"))
  scen_means <- aggregate(TotalATE ~ Law + Contrast + Model, scen_boot_df, mean)
  ggplot(scen_boot_df, aes(x = TotalATE, fill = Model)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 30, alpha = 0.55, position = "identity") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
    geom_vline(data = scen_means, aes(xintercept = TotalATE, colour = Model),
               linewidth = 0.9, show.legend = FALSE) +
    facet_grid(Law ~ Contrast, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Naive (C)" = "#fdb462", "SEM (D)" = "#80b1d3")) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("Naive (C)" = "#e6550d", "SEM (D)" = "#3182bd")) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-1000, 1000)) +
    labs(
      x = bquote("Bias-corrected bootstrap " ~ hat(Delta) ~ "(total saved /" ~ .(ate_days) ~ "days)"),
      y = "Bootstrap replicate count",
      fill = "Model",
      title = "Four-scenario ATE bootstrap comparison",
      subtitle = paste(scen_n_note, collapse = " · ")
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
    )
} else {
  plot.new()
  text(0.5, 0.5, "Four-scenario RDS files not found under oklahoma output.")
}
```

```{r fig-ate-bootstrap-cd}
#| label: fig-ate-bootstrap-cd
#| fig-cap: "Bias-corrected bootstrap replicate distribution of total saved for the primary KDE pair C/D, using all finite ATEs retained after failed or explosive refits are excluded. Shape/spread preserved, recentered to the point ATE."
#| fig-height: 4
#| eval: !expr '!using_pre_bootstrap && !is.null(boot_naive_df) && !is.null(boot_sem_df)'
# Labels / centers follow results$config$ATE_METHOD for this RDS.
if (!is.null(boot_naive_df) && !is.null(boot_sem_df) &&
    nrow(boot_naive_df) > 0 && nrow(boot_sem_df) > 0 &&
    "ate_total_mean" %in% names(boot_naive_df) && "ate_total_mean" %in% names(boot_sem_df)) {
  get_fit_obj_by_id <- function(id) {
    switch(
      toupper(id),
      "C" = fit_C_obj,
      "D" = fit_D_obj,
      "E" = fit_E_obj,
      "F" = fit_F_obj,
      NULL
    )
  }
  obs_ate_mean <- function(id) {
    fo <- get_fit_obj_by_id(id)
    if (is.null(fo) || is.null(fo$ate)) return(NA_real_)
    vals <- get_total_effect_sim(fo$ate, n_tiles = n_cty)
    vals <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(vals))
    vals <- vals[is.finite(vals)]
    if (length(vals) < 1L) return(NA_real_)
    mean(vals, na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  recenter_boot <- function(boot_vals, target_mean) {
    bv <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(boot_vals))
    if (!is.finite(target_mean) || is.na(target_mean)) return(bv)
    bmean <- mean(bv, na.rm = TRUE)
    if (!is.finite(bmean) || is.na(bmean)) return(bv)
    bv + (target_mean - bmean)
  }

  naive_obs_mean <- obs_ate_mean(boot_naive_id)
  sem_obs_mean <- obs_ate_mean(boot_sem_id)
  naive_filt <- retain_boot_vals(boot_naive_df$ate_total_mean)
  sem_filt <- retain_boot_vals(boot_sem_df$ate_total_mean)
  naive_bc_vals <- recenter_boot(naive_filt$vals, naive_obs_mean)
  sem_bc_vals <- recenter_boot(sem_filt$vals, sem_obs_mean)

  boot_cd <- rbind(
    data.frame(Model = boot_naive_label, TotalATE = naive_bc_vals),
    data.frame(Model = boot_sem_label, TotalATE = sem_bc_vals)
  )
  boot_cd <- boot_cd[is.finite(boot_cd$TotalATE), , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(boot_cd) > 0) {
    boot_means <- aggregate(TotalATE ~ Model, boot_cd, mean)
    n_drop <- naive_filt$n_out + sem_filt$n_out
    ggplot(boot_cd, aes(x = TotalATE, fill = Model)) +
      geom_histogram(bins = 30, alpha = 0.55, position = "identity") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
      geom_vline(data = boot_means, aes(xintercept = TotalATE, colour = Model),
                 linetype = "solid", linewidth = 0.9, show.legend = FALSE) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(c("#fdb462", "#80b1d3"), c(boot_naive_label, boot_sem_label))) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = setNames(c("#e6550d", "#3182bd"), c(boot_naive_label, boot_sem_label))) +
      coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-1000, 1000)) +
      labs(x = bquote(hat(Delta)[AoN] ~ "(bias-corrected bootstrap replicate mean total saved /" ~ .(ate_days) ~ "days)"),
           y = "Bootstrap replicate count",
           title = paste0("Bias-corrected bootstrap AoN total-saved distribution (", boot_pair_label, ")"),
           subtitle = sprintf(
             "Centers: %s=%.1f, %s=%.1f; retained stable finite ATEs %d/%d (%s) and %d/%d (%s); %d non-finite ATE(s) omitted",
             boot_naive_id, naive_obs_mean, boot_sem_id, sem_obs_mean,
             length(naive_filt$vals), naive_filt$n_in, boot_naive_id,
             length(sem_filt$vals), sem_filt$n_in, boot_sem_id,
             n_drop
           )) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
      theme(legend.position = "top",
            plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
            plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10))
  } else {
    plot.new()
    text(0.5, 0.5, sprintf("Bias-corrected bootstrap %s replicate means are present but non-finite.", boot_pair_label))
  }
} else {
  plot.new()
  text(0.5, 0.5, sprintf("Bias-corrected bootstrap %s results are unavailable in this results checkpoint.", boot_pair_label))
}
```

```{r fig-ate-bootstrap-biv-obs}
#| label: fig-ate-bootstrap-biv-obs

#| eval: !expr '!using_pre_bootstrap && !is.null(boot_obj)'
# Companion scenario RDS written by launch_ate_scenarios_nesi.sh / bootstrap-only jobs.
biv_obs_candidates <- unique(c(
  file.path(OUT_DIR, "for_paper_biv_obs.rds"),

if (!using_pre_bootstrap && !is.na(biv_obs_file) && nzchar(biv_obs_file)) {
  res_obs <- normalize_oklahoma_fit_letters(readRDS(biv_obs_file))
  boot_obs <- res_obs$bootstrap_ate
  fit_C_obs <- if (!is.null(res_obs$fits_named)) res_obs$fits_named$C else NULL
  fit_D_obs <- if (!is.null(res_obs$fits_named)) res_obs$fits_named$D else NULL
  boot_C_blk <- if (!is.null(boot_obs$fit_C)) boot_obs$fit_C else boot_obs$fit_E
  boot_D_blk <- if (!is.null(boot_obs$fit_D)) boot_obs$fit_D else boot_obs$fit_F
  boot_C_obs <- if (!is.null(boot_C_blk)) boot_C_blk$replicate_summary else NULL
  boot_D_obs <- if (!is.null(boot_D_blk)) boot_D_blk$replicate_summary else NULL
  if (!is.null(boot_C_obs) && "is_stable" %in% names(boot_C_obs)) {
    boot_C_obs <- boot_C_obs[
      !is.na(boot_C_obs$is_stable) & boot_C_obs$is_stable, , drop = FALSE
    ]
  }
  if (!is.null(boot_D_obs) && "is_stable" %in% names(boot_D_obs)) {
    boot_D_obs <- boot_D_obs[
      !is.na(boot_D_obs$is_stable) & boot_D_obs$is_stable, , drop = FALSE
    ]
  }
  if (!is.null(boot_C_obs) && !is.null(boot_D_obs) &&
      nrow(boot_C_obs) > 0 && nrow(boot_D_obs) > 0 &&
      "ate_total_mean" %in% names(boot_C_obs) && "ate_total_mean" %in% names(boot_D_obs)) {
    obs_ate_mean_from_fit <- function(fit_obj) {
      if (is.null(fit_obj) || is.null(fit_obj$ate)) return(NA_real_)
      vals <- get_total_effect_sim(fit_obj$ate, n_tiles = n_cty)
      vals <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(vals))
      vals <- vals[is.finite(vals)]
      if (length(vals) < 1L) return(NA_real_)
      mean(vals, na.rm = TRUE)
    }
    recenter_boot_obs <- function(boot_vals, target_mean) {
      bv <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(boot_vals))
      if (!is.finite(target_mean) || is.na(target_mean)) return(bv)
      bmean <- mean(bv, na.rm = TRUE)
      if (!is.finite(bmean) || is.na(bmean)) return(bv)
      bv + (target_mean - bmean)
    }
    lab_C <- "C: Naive Biv+KDE (all-free)"
    lab_D <- "D: SEM Biv+KDE (all-free)"
    mean_C_obs <- obs_ate_mean_from_fit(fit_C_obs)
    mean_D_obs <- obs_ate_mean_from_fit(fit_D_obs)
    filt_C_obs <- retain_boot_vals(boot_C_obs$ate_total_mean)
    filt_D_obs <- retain_boot_vals(boot_D_obs$ate_total_mean)
    boot_cd_obs <- rbind(

      data.frame(Model = lab_D, TotalATE = recenter_boot_obs(filt_D_obs$vals, mean_D_obs))
    )
    boot_cd_obs <- boot_cd_obs[is.finite(boot_cd_obs$TotalATE), , drop = FALSE]
    if (nrow(boot_cd_obs) > 0) {

      ggplot(boot_cd_obs, aes(x = TotalATE, fill = Model)) +
        geom_histogram(bins = 30, alpha = 0.55, position = "identity") +
        geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
        geom_vline(data = boot_means_obs, aes(xintercept = TotalATE, colour = Model),
                   linetype = "solid", linewidth = 0.9, show.legend = FALSE) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(c("#fdb462", "#80b1d3"), c(lab_C, lab_D))) +
        scale_colour_manual(values = setNames(c("#e6550d", "#3182bd"), c(lab_C, lab_D))) +
        coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-1000, 1000)) +
        labs(
          x = bquote(hat(Delta)[obs] ~ "(bias-corrected bootstrap replicate mean total saved /" ~ .(ate_days_obs) ~ "days)"),
          y = "Bootstrap replicate count",
          title = "Bias-corrected bootstrap observed-vs-control distribution (C/D, bivariate)",
          subtitle = sprintf(
            "Contrast: bivariate/observed; centers C=%.1f, D=%.1f; retained stable finite ATEs %d/%d (C) and %d/%d (D); omitted %d non-finite; source %s",
            mean_C_obs, mean_D_obs,
            length(filt_C_obs$vals), filt_C_obs$n_in,
            length(filt_D_obs$vals), filt_D_obs$n_in,
            n_drop_obs,
            basename(biv_obs_file)
          )
        ) +
        theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
        theme(
          legend.position = "top",
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10)
        )
    } else {
      plot.new()
      text(0.5, 0.5, "Bivariate observed bootstrap replicate means are present but non-finite.")
    }
  } else {
    plot.new()
    text(0.5, 0.5, sprintf("Bivariate observed bootstrap C/D summaries missing in %s.", basename(biv_obs_file)))
  }
} else {
  plot.new()
  text(0.5, 0.5, "Bivariate observed scenario RDS not found (expected for_paper_biv_obs.rds).")
}
```

# Partition Sensitivity

The analysis is repeated under alternative spatial partitions to assess
sensitivity to spatial resolution:

- **Grid partitions** with cell diameters equal to 1, 2, and 5
  times the estimated triggering range
  (`r fmt_scaled_num(if (!is.null(results$kde_info)) results$kde_info$trigger_range_km else NULL)` km).
- **AOI region** partition: the AOI polygon defines one treated region,
  everything else is control (2 tiles total).

For each partition, both the naive bivariate + KDE (C-type, all-free)
and SEM bivariate + KDE (D-type, all-free) models are fitted. The maps
below use the same pre/post overlay as the tessellation point-pattern figure.

The log-likelihood table below scores every tessellation's fitted
parameters on the **same AOI geometry** (OCC polygon = treated, complement =
control, same KDE field). **Fit C LL** uses that tessellation's naive C
parameters with AOI-boundary labels (C's native complete-data labelling).
The D columns keep that tessellation's SEM-D parameters and change only
the process labels: the SEM's last proposed labelling versus the
AOI-boundary location labels. A higher last-labelling likelihood means
the sampler's proposed labels outscore the geographic AOI assignment
under that tessellation's fitted D model. Pre-treatment events remain
control in every column.

A separate parameter table lists the fitted bivariate ETAS coefficients
for C and D on each partition (background, productivity, cross-excitation,
shared structural terms, and branching). Use it to see whether a tessellation
stays C-like (\(\mu_1\gg\mu_0\), moderate \(\rho\)) or walks toward a
low-background, near-critical treated Hawkes.

```{r prep-partition-overlays}
#| label: prep-partition-overlays
#| include: false
geom_path <- file.path(SCRIPT_DIR, "oklahoma_geometry.R")
if (file.exists(geom_path) && !exists("oklahoma_sf_to_owin_km", mode = "function")) {
  source(geom_path, local = FALSE)
}
support_path <- file.path(SCRIPT_DIR, "oklahoma_report_support.R")
if (file.exists(support_path) && !exists("oklahoma_report_plot_partition_pp", mode = "function")) {
  source(support_path, local = FALSE)
}

partition_overlay_specs <- list()
partition_overlay_caps <- character(0)
pr_overlay <- results$partition_results
if (!is.null(pr_overlay) && length(pr_overlay) >= 1L &&
    exists("oklahoma_sf_to_owin_km", mode = "function") &&
    exists("oklahoma_report_plot_partition_pp", mode = "function") &&
    exists("counties_km") && exists("aoi_sf") && exists("counties_sf")) {
  xs <- c(pp_pre$x, pp_post$x)
  ys <- c(pp_pre$y, pp_post$y)
  xs <- xs[is.finite(xs)]
  ys <- ys[is.finite(ys)]
  if (length(xs) > 0L && length(ys) > 0L) {
    xlims_part <- range(xs, na.rm = TRUE)
    ylims_part <- range(ys, na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    bb_map <- sf::st_bbox(counties_km)
    xlims_part <- as.numeric(bb_map[c("xmin", "xmax")])
    ylims_part <- as.numeric(bb_map[c("ymin", "ymax")])
  }
  theme_part <- ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
  fill_vals <- c(control = "#deebf7", treated = "#fc9272")

  ok_boundary <- sf::st_union(counties_sf)
  ok_boundary <- sf::st_make_valid(ok_boundary)
  win_km_part <- oklahoma_sf_to_owin_km(ok_boundary)
  aoi_union_part <- sf::st_union(sf::st_make_valid(aoi_sf))
  aoi_owin_part <- tryCatch(
    oklahoma_sf_to_owin_km(aoi_union_part),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  aoi_km <- aoi_sf
  sf::st_geometry(aoi_km) <- sf::st_geometry(aoi_sf) / 1000
  sf::st_crs(aoi_km) <- NA

  trigger_km <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(results$kde_info$trigger_range_km))
  if (!is.finite(trigger_km) || trigger_km <= 0) {
    trigger_km <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(cfg$spatial_scale_D))
  }
  grid_mults <- unique(c(
    1.0, 2.0, 5.0,
    suppressWarnings(as.numeric(unlist(cfg$grid_multipliers)))
  ))
  grid_mults <- grid_mults[is.finite(grid_mults)]
  test_mode <- isTRUE(cfg$TEST_MODE)
  grid_max_lookup <- if (isTRUE(test_mode)) {
    c(`1` = 2000L, `2` = 1600L, `5` = 1200L)
  } else {
    c(`1` = 5000L, `2` = 3000L, `5` = 1500L)
  }
  grid_max_tiles <- unname(grid_max_lookup[as.character(as.integer(grid_mults))])
  grid_max_tiles[is.na(grid_max_tiles)] <- if (isTRUE(test_mode)) 1600L else 3000L

  wanted <- unique(c(primary_partition_id, "county", names(pr_overlay)))
  wanted <- wanted[wanted %in% c("county", names(pr_overlay), "aoi_region", primary_partition_id) |
                     grepl("^grid_", wanted)]
  order_ids <- unique(c(
    primary_partition_id,
    "county",
    sort(wanted[grepl("^grid_", wanted)]),
    "aoi_region"
  ))
  order_ids <- intersect(order_ids, wanted)

  for (pid in order_ids) {
    lab <- format_partition_label(pid)
    spec <- NULL
    if (identical(pid, "county")) {
      spec <- list(
        kind = "sf",
        tiles = counties_km,
        post = {
          out <- pp_post
          process_col <- dplyr::case_when(
            "location_process" %in% names(out) ~ "location_process",
            "inferred_process" %in% names(out) ~ "inferred_process",
            "process" %in% names(out) ~ "process",
            TRUE ~ NA_character_
          )
          if (is.na(process_col)) {
            out$Process <- factor(rep("control", nrow(out)), levels = c("control", "treated"))
          } else {
            out$Process <- factor(as.character(out[[process_col]]), levels = c("control", "treated"))
          }
          out
        }
      )
    } else if (grepl("^grid_", pid) && !is.null(aoi_owin_part)) {
      if (identical(pid, "grid_coarse")) {
        gp <- oklahoma_report_grid_partition(
          diameter = NA_real_,
          win = win_km_part,
          aoi_owin = aoi_owin_part,
          label = pid,
          max_tiles = 2000L
        )
      } else {
        if (!is.finite(trigger_km)) next
        mult <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sub("^grid_([0-9.]+)R$", "\\1", pid)))
        if (!is.finite(mult)) next
        mi <- match(mult, grid_mults)
        if (is.na(mi)) mi <- which.min(abs(grid_mults - mult))
        gp <- oklahoma_report_grid_partition(
          diameter = mult * trigger_km,
          win = win_km_part,
          aoi_owin = aoi_owin_part,
          label = pid,
          max_tiles = grid_max_tiles[[max(1L, as.integer(mi))]]
        )
      }
      post <- pp_post
      post$Process <- factor(
        oklahoma_assign_partition_process(post$x, post$y, gp$partition, gp$processes),
        levels = c("control", "treated")
      )
      spec <- list(
        kind = "rect",
        tiles = oklahoma_report_tess_rects(gp$partition, gp$processes),
        post = post
      )
    } else if (identical(pid, "aoi_region") && !is.null(aoi_owin_part)) {
      aoi_treat <- tryCatch(
        sf::st_make_valid(sf::st_intersection(sf::st_union(aoi_km), sf::st_union(counties_km))),
        error = function(e) sf::st_union(aoi_km)
      )
      aoi_ctrl <- tryCatch(
        sf::st_make_valid(sf::st_difference(sf::st_union(counties_km), aoi_treat)),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      tiles <- rbind(
        sf::st_sf(treatment = "treated", geometry = sf::st_geometry(aoi_treat))
      )
      if (!is.null(aoi_ctrl) && !sf::st_is_empty(aoi_ctrl)) {
        tiles <- rbind(
          tiles,
          sf::st_sf(treatment = "control", geometry = sf::st_geometry(aoi_ctrl))
        )
      }
      post <- pp_post
      post$Process <- factor(
        ifelse(spatstat.geom::inside.owin(post$x, post$y, aoi_owin_part), "treated", "control"),
        levels = c("control", "treated")
      )
      spec <- list(kind = "sf", tiles = tiles, post = post)
    }
    if (is.null(spec)) next
    spec$id <- pid
    spec$label <- lab
    spec$xlims <- xlims_part
    spec$ylims <- ylims_part
    spec$theme <- theme_part
    spec$fill_vals <- fill_vals
    partition_overlay_specs[[length(partition_overlay_specs) + 1L]] <- spec
    partition_overlay_caps <- c(
      partition_overlay_caps,
      sprintf(
        "Pre-treatment (left) and post-treatment (right) events overlaid on the %s partition.",
        lab
      )
    )
  }
}
```

```{r tbl-partition-sensitivity}
#| label: tbl-partition-sensitivity
pr <- results$partition_results
ap <- results$ate_partitions
if (is.null(pr)) pr <- list()
primary_info <- list(
  label = primary_partition_id,
  E_params = if (!is.null(fit_C_obj)) fit_C_obj$params else NULL,
  F_params = if (!is.null(fit_D_obj)) fit_D_obj$params else NULL,
  semF = sem_fit_obj(fit_D_obj),
  n_tiles = n_cty,
  n_treated = suppressWarnings(as.integer(unlist(cfg$n_treated, use.names = FALSE)))[1],
  n_relabel = NA_integer_
)
if (!primary_partition_id %in% names(pr)) {
  pr <- c(setNames(list(primary_info), primary_partition_id), pr)
}

part_rows <- list()
for (pname in names(pr)) {
  info <- pr[[pname]]
  ate_info <- if (identical(info$label, primary_partition_id)) {
    list(ate_E = if (!is.null(fit_C_obj)) fit_C_obj$ate else NULL,
         ate_F = if (!is.null(fit_D_obj)) fit_D_obj$ate else NULL)
  } else {
    ap[[pname]]
  }

  for (fit_type in list(
    list(lab = "C: Naive Biv+KDE (all-free)", par = info$E_params, ate = ate_info$ate_E, sem_obj = NULL),
    list(lab = "D: SEM Biv+KDE (all-free)",   par = info$F_params, ate = ate_info$ate_F, sem_obj = info$semF)
  )) {
    expected <- if (!is.null(fit_type$ate)) {
      get_expected_totals(fit_type$ate, n_tiles = info$n_tiles)
    } else { NULL }
    sim_totals <- if (!is.null(fit_type$ate)) {
      get_total_effect_sim(fit_type$ate, n_tiles = info$n_tiles)
    } else { NULL }
    c_mean <- if (!is.null(expected) && !is.null(expected$c_total)) {
      mean(expected$c_total, na.rm = TRUE)
    } else { NA_real_ }
    t_mean <- if (!is.null(expected) && !is.null(expected$t_total)) {
      mean(expected$t_total, na.rm = TRUE)
    } else { NA_real_ }
    t_all_mean <- if (!is.null(fit_type$ate$analytic) && !is.null(fit_type$ate$analytic$eta_treat)) {
      as.numeric(fit_type$ate$analytic$eta_treat) * info$n_tiles
    } else { NA_real_ }
    saved_diff_mean <- if (is.finite(c_mean) && is.finite(t_mean)) c_mean - t_mean else NA_real_
    sim_sd_total <- if (!is.null(sim_totals) && length(sim_totals) > 1L) {
      sd(sim_totals, na.rm = TRUE)
    } else { NA_real_ }
    spill_total <- if (!is.null(fit_type$ate$total_spillover)) {
      fit_type$ate$total_spillover
    } else if (!is.null(fit_type$ate$ATE_spillover)) {
      fit_type$ate$ATE_spillover * info$n_tiles
    } else { NA_real_ }
    n_post <- NA_integer_
    if (!is.null(info$n_post_ctrl) && !is.null(info$n_post_treat) &&
        is.finite(info$n_post_ctrl) && is.finite(info$n_post_treat)) {
      n_post <- as.integer(info$n_post_ctrl) + as.integer(info$n_post_treat)
    } else if (identical(info$label, primary_partition_id) && exists("pp_post") && !is.null(pp_post)) {
      n_post <- as.integer(nrow(pp_post))
    }
    n_relabel <- if (!is.null(fit_type$sem_obj) &&
                     !is.null(fit_type$sem_obj$adaptive$adaptive_labelling)) {
      lp <- fit_type$sem_obj$adaptive$adaptive_labelling
      lp <- lp[lp$t >= 0, , drop = FALSE]
      sum(lp$location_process != lp$inferred_process, na.rm = TRUE)
    } else if (identical(fit_type$lab, "D: SEM Biv+KDE (all-free)") &&
               !is.null(info$n_relabel) && is.finite(info$n_relabel)) {
      as.integer(info$n_relabel)
    } else {
      NA_integer_
    }
    relabel_txt <- if (!grepl("^D:", fit_type$lab)) {
      "—"
    } else if (is.finite(n_relabel) && is.finite(n_post) && n_post > 0L) {
      sprintf("%d / %d", as.integer(n_relabel), as.integer(n_post))
    } else if (is.finite(n_relabel)) {
      as.character(as.integer(n_relabel))
    } else {
      "NA"
    }
    rnd <- function(x, digits = 0L) {
      v <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x)[1L])
      if (!is.finite(v)) NA_real_ else round(v, digits)
    }
    pget <- function(par, nm) {
      if (is.null(par)) return(NA_real_)
      v <- tryCatch(par[[nm]], error = function(e) NULL)
      suppressWarnings(as.numeric(v)[1L])
    }

    part_rows[[length(part_rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      PartitionID = info$label,
      Partition = format_partition_label(info$label),
      Model = fit_type$lab,
      Tiles = info$n_tiles,
      Treated = info$n_treated,
      `Relabelled / post` = relabel_txt,
      `E[N(control everywhere)]` = rnd(c_mean, 0),
      `E[N(actual treatment regime)]` = rnd(t_mean, 0),
      `E[N(treated everywhere)]` = rnd(t_all_mean, 0),
      `Saved = control - actual` = rnd(saved_diff_mean, 0),
      `SD(saved)` = rnd(sim_sd_total, 0),
      `Spillover` = rnd(spill_total, 0),
      mu_0 = rnd(pget(fit_type$par, "mu_0"), 4),
      mu_1 = rnd(pget(fit_type$par, "mu_1"), 4),
      A_0 = rnd(pget(fit_type$par, "A_00"), 4),
      A_1 = rnd(pget(fit_type$par, "A_11"), 4),
      alpha_m_0 = rnd(pget(fit_type$par, "alpha_m_00"), 4),
      alpha_m_1 = rnd(pget(fit_type$par, "alpha_m_11"), 4),
      check.names = FALSE)
  }
}

if (length(part_rows) > 0) {
  part_df <- do.call(rbind, part_rows)
  # Keep the primary tessellation first, then remaining partitions.
  part_ids <- unique(as.character(part_df$PartitionID))
  part_df$PartitionID <- factor(part_df$PartitionID,
                                levels = c(primary_partition_id,
                                           sort(setdiff(part_ids, primary_partition_id))))
  part_df <- part_df[order(part_df$PartitionID, part_df$Model), ]
  part_df$Partition <- factor(as.character(part_df$Partition),
                              levels = unique(as.character(part_df$Partition)))
  part_df_print <- subset(part_df, select = -PartitionID)
  rownames(part_df_print) <- NULL
  kable(part_df_print, align = "llccccccccccccccc", row.names = FALSE,
        caption = paste0("Partition comparison over ", ate_days, " days using the same expected-count and ATE metrics as Section 6.1 (plus marginal ETAS parameters). SEM relabels are post-treatment events whose inferred process differs from the partition location label; naive Fit C does not relabel.")) |>
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover"), full_width = FALSE,
                  font_size = 9, latex_options = c("scale_down", "hold_position"))
}
```

```{r tbl-partition-params}
#| label: tbl-partition-params
#| tbl-cap: "Bivariate ETAS parameters for C (location labels) and D (SEM) on each partition. Branching ratios are A*beta/(beta-alpha); rho is the offspring spectral radius. Shared structural terms (c, p, D, q) are one value per bivariate fit (gamma = 0)."
pnum <- function(par, nm) {
  if (is.null(par)) return(NA_real_)
  if (is.list(par) && nm %in% names(par)) {
    v <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(par[[nm]]))
    return(if (length(v) && is.finite(v[[1]])) v[[1]] else NA_real_)
  }
  pv <- tryCatch(unlist(par), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(pv) || is.null(names(pv)) || !nm %in% names(pv)) return(NA_real_)
  v <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(pv[[nm]]))
  if (!length(v) || !is.finite(v[[1]])) return(NA_real_)
  v[[1]]
}
beta_part <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(unlist(cfg$BETA_GR, use.names = FALSE)))
beta_part <- beta_part[is.finite(beta_part) & beta_part > 0]
beta_part <- if (length(beta_part)) beta_part[[1]] else 2.3
eta_part <- function(A, alpha, beta_gr = beta_part) {
  if (!is.finite(A) || !is.finite(alpha) || !is.finite(beta_gr) || beta_gr <= 0) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  gap <- beta_gr - alpha
  if (!is.finite(gap) || gap <= 1e-8) return(Inf)
  A * beta_gr / gap
}
rho_part <- function(par) {
  e00 <- eta_part(pnum(par, "A_00"), pnum(par, "alpha_m_00"))
  e01 <- eta_part(pnum(par, "A_01"), pnum(par, "alpha_m_01"))
  e10 <- eta_part(pnum(par, "A_10"), pnum(par, "alpha_m_10"))
  e11 <- eta_part(pnum(par, "A_11"), pnum(par, "alpha_m_11"))
  M <- matrix(c(e00, e01, e10, e11), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)
  if (!all(is.finite(M))) return(Inf)
  max(Re(eigen(M, only.values = TRUE)$values))
}
fmt_part <- function(x, digits = 4L) {
  if (length(x) < 1L || is.null(x) || is.na(x)) return("—")
  if (!is.finite(x)) return("Inf")
  sprintf(paste0("%.", as.integer(digits), "f"), as.numeric(x))
}
fmt_tiny <- function(x) {
  if (length(x) < 1L || is.null(x) || is.na(x)) return("—")
  if (!is.finite(x)) return("Inf")
  if (abs(x) > 0 && abs(x) < 1e-3) return(format(signif(x, 3), scientific = TRUE))
  sprintf("%.4f", x)
}

part_param_rows <- list()
if (exists("pr") && length(pr) > 0L) {
  part_ids_p <- unique(as.character(unlist(lapply(pr, function(z) z$label))))
  part_ids_p <- c(primary_partition_id, sort(setdiff(part_ids_p, primary_partition_id)))
  part_ids_p <- intersect(part_ids_p, unique(c(names(pr), primary_partition_id)))
  for (pid in part_ids_p) {
    info <- pr[[pid]]
    if (is.null(info)) next
    for (ft in list(
      list(lab = "C", par = info$E_params),
      list(lab = "D", par = info$F_params)
    )) {
      par <- ft$par
      if (is.null(par)) next
      e00 <- eta_part(pnum(par, "A_00"), pnum(par, "alpha_m_00"))
      e11 <- eta_part(pnum(par, "A_11"), pnum(par, "alpha_m_11"))
      part_param_rows[[length(part_param_rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
        Partition = format_partition_label(pid),
        Model = ft$lab,
        mu_0 = fmt_part(pnum(par, "mu_0")),
        mu_1 = fmt_part(pnum(par, "mu_1")),
        A_00 = fmt_part(pnum(par, "A_00")),
        A_11 = fmt_part(pnum(par, "A_11")),
        alpha_00 = fmt_part(pnum(par, "alpha_m_00")),
        alpha_11 = fmt_part(pnum(par, "alpha_m_11")),
        A_01 = fmt_tiny(pnum(par, "A_01")),
        A_10 = fmt_tiny(pnum(par, "A_10")),
        c = fmt_tiny(pnum(par, "c")),
        p = fmt_part(pnum(par, "p")),
        D = fmt_part(pnum(par, "D")),
        q = fmt_part(pnum(par, "q")),
        eta_00 = fmt_part(e00, 3L),
        eta_11 = fmt_part(e11, 3L),
        rho = fmt_part(rho_part(par), 3L),
        check.names = FALSE,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  }
}
if (length(part_param_rows) > 0L) {
  part_param_df <- do.call(rbind, part_param_rows)
  rownames(part_param_df) <- NULL
  kable(
    part_param_df,
    align = "llcccccccccccccccc",
    row.names = FALSE,
    col.names = c(
      "Partition", "Model",
      "$\\mu_0$", "$\\mu_1$",
      "$A_{00}$", "$A_{11}$",
      "$\\alpha_{00}$", "$\\alpha_{11}$",
      "$A_{01}$", "$A_{10}$",
      "$c$", "$p$", "$D$", "$q$",
      "$\\eta_{00}$", "$\\eta_{11}$", "$\\rho$"
    ),
    escape = FALSE
  ) |>
    kable_styling(
      bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "bordered"),
      full_width = FALSE, font_size = 8,
      latex_options = c("scale_down", "hold_position")
    ) |>
    scroll_box(width = "100%")
} else {
  cat("Partition C/D parameters are not stored in this results file.\n")
}
```

```{r tbl-partition-sem-aoi-loglik}
                  full_width = FALSE, font_size = 10)
} else {
  cat("C/D AOI-vs-last-labelling log-likelihoods could not be rebuilt from this results file (need KDE holdout, AOI geometry, and Fit C or Fit D parameters).\n")
}
```

```{r fig-partition-ate}
  part_sim_ids <- unique(as.character(part_sim$PartitionID))
  part_sim$PartitionID <- factor(part_sim$PartitionID,
                                 levels = c(primary_partition_id,
                                            sort(setdiff(part_sim_ids, primary_partition_id))))
  part_order <- unique(as.character(part_sim[order(part_sim$PartitionID), "Partition"]))
  part_sim$Partition <- factor(part_sim$Partition, levels = part_order)
  p_part <- ggplot(part_sim, aes(x = TotalATE, fill = Model)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 25, alpha = 0.55, position = "identity") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
    facet_wrap(~Partition, scales = "fixed") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("C: Naive Biv+KDE (all-free)" = "#fdb462", "D: SEM Biv+KDE (all-free)" = "#80b1d3")) +
    labs(x = bquote(hat(Delta)[AoN] ~ "(total earthquakes saved /" ~ .(ate_days) ~ "days)"),
         y = "Simulation count") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "top",
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))
  if (!is.null(biv_xlim) && all(is.finite(biv_xlim))) {
    p_part <- p_part + coord_cartesian(xlim = biv_xlim)
  }
  print(p_part)
}
```

# SEM initialization variability (Fit D)

Each replicate below starts from **that tessellation's C MLE** $\theta$ and an independent sequential Bernoulli labelling of post-treatment events, then polishes for the configured SEM inner steps. This is initialization variability, not the parametric bootstrap.


# Interpretation

```{r summaries, include=FALSE}
n_cty_interp <- if (!is.null(cfg$n_tiles)) cfg$n_tiles else cfg$n_counties
ate_days_interp <- if (!is.null(cfg$ATE_WINDOW_DAYS)) cfg$ATE_WINDOW_DAYS else 100

safe_mu_ratio <- function(par) {
  if (is.null(par)) return(NA_real_)
  denom <- safe_bc(par, "mu")
  numer <- safe_bt(par, "mu")
  if (!is.finite(denom) || is.na(denom) || abs(denom) < .Machine$double.eps) return(NA_real_)
  numer / denom
}
mu_ratio_C <- safe_mu_ratio(C_par)
mu_ratio_D <- safe_mu_ratio(D_par)
mu_ratio_E <- safe_mu_ratio(E_par)
mu_ratio_F <- safe_mu_ratio(F_par)
mu_ratio_G <- safe_mu_ratio(G_par)
mu_ratio_H <- safe_mu_ratio(H_par)

total_C_1yr <- if (!is.null(fit_C_obj) && !is.null(fit_C_obj$ate)) round(mean(get_total_effect_sim(fit_C_obj$ate, n_tiles = n_cty_interp), na.rm=TRUE), 0) else NA
total_D_1yr <- if (!is.null(fit_D_obj) && !is.null(fit_D_obj$ate)) round(mean(get_total_effect_sim(fit_D_obj$ate, n_tiles = n_cty_interp), na.rm=TRUE), 0) else NA
total_E_1yr <- if (!is.null(fit_E_obj) && !is.null(fit_E_obj$ate)) round(mean(get_total_effect_sim(fit_E_obj$ate, n_tiles = n_cty_interp), na.rm=TRUE), 0) else NA
total_F_1yr <- if (!is.null(fit_F_obj) && !is.null(fit_F_obj$ate)) round(mean(get_total_effect_sim(fit_F_obj$ate, n_tiles = n_cty_interp), na.rm=TRUE), 0) else NA
total_G_1yr <- if (!is.null(fit_G_obj) && !is.null(fit_G_obj$ate)) round(mean(get_total_effect_sim(fit_G_obj$ate, n_tiles = n_cty_interp), na.rm=TRUE), 0) else NA
total_H_1yr <- if (!is.null(fit_H_obj) && !is.null(fit_H_obj$ate)) round(mean(get_total_effect_sim(fit_H_obj$ate, n_tiles = n_cty_interp), na.rm=TRUE), 0) else NA
total_J_1yr <- if (!is.null(fit_J_obj) && !is.null(fit_J_obj$ate)) round(mean(get_total_effect_sim(fit_J_obj$ate, n_tiles = n_cty_interp), na.rm=TRUE), 0) else NA

effect_direction <- function(x, tol = 10) {
  if (is.na(x)) return("unavailable")
  if (x > tol) return("worse under treatment")
  if (x < -tol) return("beneficial under treatment")
  "close to no detectable difference"
}
```

**Inhomogeneous background rate focus.** Fits C and D (primary all-free)
use a spatially inhomogeneous background estimated from the first half of
control pre-treatment data. This provides an independent estimate of
the baseline seismicity pattern without using post-treatment data.

**Background contrast (inhomogeneous variants).** The treated-to-control
background ratio $\mu_1/\mu_0$ is:
`r paste(sprintf("C=%.1fx, D=%.1fx, E=%.1fx, F=%.1fx, G=%.1fx, H=%.1fx",
                 mu_ratio_C, mu_ratio_D, mu_ratio_E, mu_ratio_F, mu_ratio_G, mu_ratio_H), collapse = "")`.

**All-or-nothing total saved (`r ate_days_interp`-day horizon).**

```{r interp-effects, results='asis'}
effect_lines <- c(
  paste0("- **Fit C (naive+KDE, all-free):** $\\hat\\Delta_{\\text{AoN}}=$ **", total_C_1yr, "** total earthquakes saved / ", ate_days_interp, " days"),
  paste0("- **Fit D (SEM+KDE, all-free):** $\\hat\\Delta_{\\text{AoN}}=$ **", total_D_1yr, "** total earthquakes saved / ", ate_days_interp, " days"),
  paste0("- **Fit E (naive+KDE, struct-fixed):** $\\hat\\Delta_{\\text{AoN}}=$ **", total_E_1yr, "** total earthquakes saved / ", ate_days_interp, " days"),
  paste0("- **Fit F (SEM+KDE, struct-fixed):** $\\hat\\Delta_{\\text{AoN}}=$ **", total_F_1yr, "** total earthquakes saved / ", ate_days_interp, " days"),
  {
    sem_totals <- c(total_D_1yr, total_F_1yr)
    sem_totals <- sem_totals[is.finite(sem_totals)]
    if (length(sem_totals) > 0L) {
      paste0("- **Interpretation:** Across KDE bivariate SEM fits (D/F), effects range from **",
             effect_direction(min(sem_totals)),
             "** to **",
             effect_direction(max(sem_totals)),
             "**.")
    } else {
      "- **Interpretation:** KDE SEM variant effects are unavailable in this results file."
    }
  }
)
if (!is.na(total_H_1yr)) {
  effect_lines <- c(effect_lines, paste0("- **Fit H (SEM univariate+KDE):** $\\hat\\Delta_{\\text{AoN}}=$ **", total_H_1yr, "** total earthquakes saved / ", ate_days_interp, " days"))
}
if (!is.na(total_J_1yr)) {
  effect_lines <- c(effect_lines, paste0("- **Fit J (SEM univariate, no KDE):** $\\hat\\Delta_{\\text{AoN}}=$ **", total_J_1yr, "** total earthquakes saved / ", ate_days_interp, " days"))
}
cat(paste(effect_lines, collapse = "\n"), "\n")
```

**Partition sensitivity.** The alternative partition schemes (grids at
different scales and the AOI-as-single-region partition) show how the
treatment effect estimate varies with spatial resolution. The C/D
log-likelihood table scores each tessellation's fitted parameters on the
same AOI geometry. Fit C is the naive complete-data likelihood on
AOI-boundary labels; a D last-labelling gain over D's AOI-boundary
labels is a labelling comparison rather than a change of spatial
compensator.

```{r tbl-config}
#| label: tbl-config
scalar_chr <- function(x, default = "N/A") {
  if (is.null(x)) return(default)
  xv <- unlist(x, use.names = FALSE)
  if (length(xv) < 1L) return(default)
  x1 <- xv[[1]]
  if (is.na(x1)) return(default)
  as.character(x1)
}
```
